units.korean-k7-unit: Kutaura zvisina kunanga nemazwi anobatanidza akaoma

korean-k1-l1.title: Nzvovera dzekutanga
korean-k1-l1.concept: Hangul ialfabheti yeKorea. Silabheri imwe neimwe ibumbiro. Nzvovera yoga inonyorwa ne**ㅇ** pamberi, isingatauri pakutanga: 아 ingori “a”.

korean-k1-l2.title: Mavara ekutanga asiri nzvovera
korean-k1-l2.concept: Isa vara risiri nzvovera pamberi penzvovera kuita bumbiro resilabheri: **ㄱ + ㅏ = 가** (ga). Verenga bumbiro kubva kuruboshwe kuenda kurudyi.

korean-k1-l3.title: Mazwi ekutanga
korean-k1-l3.concept: Batanidza mabumbiro esilabheri kuita mazwi. Verenga bumbiro rimwe nerimwe, wozvitaura pamwe chete.

korean-k1-l4.title: Nzvovera dzine y
korean-k1-l4.concept: Kuwedzera mutsetse mupfupi kunoita inzwi re**y**: ㅏ → ㅑ (ya), ㅓ → ㅕ (yeo), ㅗ → ㅛ (yo), ㅜ → ㅠ (yu). ㅐ (ae) neㅔ (e) zvinonzwika zvakafanana zvikuru muchiKorea chazvino.
korean-k1-l4.example: 야 · 여 · 요 · 유 (ya · yeo · yo · yu)

korean-k1-l5.title: Mamwe mavara asiri nzvovera
korean-k1-l5.concept: ㄹ iri pakati pe“r” ne“l”. ㅈ (j), ㅊ (ch, nemhepo), ㅋ (k, nemhepo), ㅌ (t, nemhepo) neㅍ (p, nemhepo) zvinopedzisa mavara ekutanga asiri nzvovera.
korean-k1-l5.example: 라 · 자 · 차 · 카 · 타 · 파 (ra · ja · cha · ka · ta · pa)

korean-k1-l6.title: Mavara akapetwa
korean-k1-l6.concept: ㄲ, ㄸ, ㅃ, ㅆ neㅉ ndiwo manzwi akasimba: ataure nomuhuro wakasimba usina mhepo, sezvazvakaita inzwi rekutanga mu“skate”.
korean-k1-l6.example: 까 · 따 · 빠 · 싸 · 짜 (kka · tta · ppa · ssa · jja)

korean-k1-l7.title: Mavara ekupedzisira
korean-k1-l7.concept: Vara riri pasi pesilabheri rinonzi **받침 (batchim)**. Rinovhara silabheri: 안 (an), 말 (mal), 밤 (bam), 강 (gang), 집 (jip), 책 (chaek). Manzwi manomwe chete ndiwo anogoneka pakupera: ㄱ ㄴ ㄷ ㄹ ㅁ ㅂ ㅇ.
korean-k1-l7.example: 안 · 말 · 밤 · 강 · 집 (an · mal · bam · gang · jip)

korean-k1-l8.title: Mazwi ezuva nezuva
korean-k1-l8.concept: Verengai izwi rimwe nerimwe silabheri nesilabheri. 학교 inoverengwa kuti “hakgyo”: vara rekupedzisira ㄱ re학 rakavharwa uye silabheri inotevera inodudzwa zvakasimba.

korean-k1-l9.title: Mazwi ezvinhu zvepasi
korean-k1-l9.concept: Vanhu nezvisikwa: 사람 (munhu), 나라 (nyika), 하늘 (denga), 산 (gomo), 강 (rwizi), 꽃 (ruva).

korean-k10-l1.title: Misoro yenhau nemaitiro akapfupikiswa
korean-k10-l1.concept: Misoro yenhau nemashoko ezita akapfupikiswa: 물가 안정 대책 발표.
korean-k10-l1.example: 물가 안정 대책을 발표했습니다. (mulga anjeong daechaegeul balpyohaesseumnida.) = vakazivisa matanho ekugadzikisa mitengo

korean-k10-l2.title: Nhau dzazvino nezvinyorwa zvemupepanhau
korean-k10-l2.concept: Kuverenga nyaya pfupi dzenhau: 친환경 에너지가 주목받고 있습니다.
korean-k10-l2.example: 친환경 에너지가 주목받고 있습니다. (chinhwan-gyeong eneojiga jumokbatgo isseumnida.) = simba risingakuvadzi nharaunda rinofarirwa

korean-k10-l3.title: Tsumo dzenhengo dzemuviri (발, 눈, 귀, 손)
korean-k10-l3.concept: Tsumo dzakajairika dzinoshandisa nhengo dzemuviri: 발이 넓다 (kuziva vanhu vakawanda), 눈이 높다 (kuva nezvinodiwa zvakakwirira).
korean-k10-l3.example: 김 대리는 발이 넓어요. (gim daerineun bari neobeoyo.) = ane vanhu vakawanda vaanoziva / 눈이 높아요. (nuni nopayo.) = anosarudza zvakanyanya

korean-k10-l4.title: Tsumo dzezviitiko zvezuva nezuva (바가지, 어깨)
korean-k10-l4.concept: Mataurirwo ezviitiko zvakajairika: 바가지를 쓰다 (kubiwa mari), 어깨가 무겁다 (mutoro unorema).
korean-k10-l4.example: 바가지를 썼어요. (bagajireul sseosseoyo.) = ndakabiwa mari nemutengo / 어깨가 무거워요. (eokkaega mugeowoyo.) = mutoro wemhanya unorema

korean-k10-l5.title: Tsumo dzakakosha dzeKorea
korean-k10-l5.concept: Uchenjeri mutsumo: 소 잃고 외양간 고친다, 쇠뿔도 단김에 빼라.
korean-k10-l5.example: 소 잃고 외양간 고친다. (so ilko oeyanggan gochinda.) = kugadzira danga mushure mekurasa nzombe / 쇠뿔도 단김에 빼라. (soeppuldo dangime ppaera.) = rova simbi ichipisa

korean-k10-l6.title: Tsumo dzemavara mana (사자성어)
korean-k10-l6.concept: Tsumo dzakajairika dzemavara mana dzinobva kuChinese: 일석이조, 작심삼일, 다다익선.
korean-k10-l6.example: 일석이조예요. (ilseogijoyeyo.) = shiri mbiri nedombo rimwe / 작심삼일이에요. (jaksimsamirieyo.) = kutsunga kwemazuva matatu

korean-k10-l7.title: Zvinongedzo zvenzira yekufunga nezviratidzo zvekutaura
korean-k10-l7.concept: Zviratidzo zvekutaura zvakanyanya kunaka: -에 따르면, 한편, 요컨대, 따라서.
korean-k10-l7.example: 의견에 따르면 그렇습니다. (uigyone ttareumyeon geureotsseumnida.) = maererano nepfungwa ndizvo / 한편 다른 측면도 있습니다. (hanpyeon dareun cheungmyeondo isseumnida.) = kune rimwe divi kune rimwe divi futi

korean-k10-l8.title: Tsika dzakadzama nemisoro yetsika yeKorea
korean-k10-l8.concept: Pfungwa dzetsika nemagariro eminyaya: 따뜻한 정, 송편을 빚다.
korean-k10-l8.example: 따뜻한 정이 있어요. (ttatteutan jeongi isseoyo.) = jeong inodziya, rudo / 송편을 빚어요. (songpyeoneul bijeoyo.) = kuumba songpyeon chuseok

korean-k10-l9.title: Ongororo Yakazara yeK10
korean-k10-l9.concept: Kunyatsoziva tsika dzeKorea, nhepfenyuro, tsumo nemataurirwo ekukakavara akasimba.
korean-k10-l9.example: 일석이조의 효과를 거두었어요. (ilseogijoui hyogwareul geoduosseoyo.) = kuwana mhedzisiro yeshiri mbiri nedombo rimwe / 상호 이해를 바탕으로 협력해요. (sangho ihaereul batangeuro hyeomnyeokaeyo.) = kubatana zvichibva pakunzwisisana

korean-k2-l1.title: Mhoro nekutenda
korean-k2-l1.concept: Kukwazisa nemutsa kunopera ne**-요** kana **-니다**. 안녕하세요 inoshanda panguva ipi neipi yezuva.

korean-k2-l10.title: Zviratidzo zvauchaona
korean-k2-l10.concept: Zviratidzo zvipfupi zviri kwese muKorea. **입구** ndiko kupinda, **출구** kubuda uye **화장실** chimbuzi. Pamikova, **미세요** zvinoreva sundira uye **당기세요** zvinoreva kwevera.

korean-k2-l11.title: Ndatenda nechikafu
korean-k2-l11.concept: Usatiwadya zvokudya taura **잘 먹겠습니다**, uye kana wapedza taura **잘 먹었습니다**. Muridzi wemba anokugamuchira ne**어서 오세요**, uye **맛있어요** inokudza chikafu.
korean-k2-l11.example: 잘 먹겠습니다. (jal meokgetseumnida.) = Inotaurwa usati wadya: “Ndichadya zvakanaka.” / 잘 먹었습니다. (jal meogeotseumnida.) = Inotaurwa mushure mekudya: “Ndadya zvakanaka.”

korean-k2-l2.title: Hongu, kwete nezvakanaka
korean-k2-l2.concept: Mhinduro pfupi dzine mutsa dzaunogona kushandisa zuva nezuva. ChiKorea chinowedzera **요** pakupera kuti chive nemutsa.

korean-k2-l3.title: Ndafara kukuona
korean-k2-l3.concept: Kana ukasangana nemunhu mutsva, taura 만나서 반갑습니다. Kune nzira mbiri dzekuti sara zvakanaka: imwe yemunhu anoenda, imwe yemunhu anosara.

korean-k2-l4.title: Mataurirwo ane mutsa
korean-k2-l4.concept: Shandisa 실례합니다 kukwevera hanya yemunhu kana kupfuura, 고마워요 kutenda munhu nemutsa wehushamwari, 천만에요 kupindura kutenda, uye 축하해요 kukorokotedza.

korean-k2-l5.title: Mazita nenyika
korean-k2-l5.concept: Bvunza zita ne 이름이 뭐예요? uye nyika ne 어느 나라 사람이에요? Pindura ne 제 이름은 ___예요 kana 저는 ___ 사람이에요.
korean-k2-l5.example: 이름이 뭐예요? (ireumi mwoyeyo?) = Zita renyu ndiani?

korean-k2-l6.title: Kuchiswa
korean-k2-l6.concept: Pakati peshamwari unogona kuti 잘 가요 (chisarai zvakanaka), 내일 봐요 (tichaonana mangwana), 또 만나요 (tichaonanazve) uye 잘 자요 (rarai zvakanaka).
korean-k2-l6.example: 잘 가요. (jal gayo.) = Chisarai zvakanaka. (zvekushamwari) / 내일 봐요. (naeil bwayo.) = Tichaonana mangwana.

korean-k2-l7.title: Makadini?
korean-k2-l7.concept: Bvunza 잘 지냈어요? (Makagara zvakanaka here?) uye pindura 잘 지내요 (Ndiri kuita zvakanaka). 좋은 아침이에요 zvinoreva kuti “Mangwanani akanaka.”
korean-k2-l7.example: 잘 지내요. (jal jinaeyo.) = Ndiri kuita zvakanaka.

korean-k2-l8.title: Kukumbira rubatsiro
korean-k2-l8.concept: Taura 도와주세요 kukumbira rubatsiro, 모르겠어요 kana usingazivi, 알겠어요 kana wanzwisisa, uye 다시 말해 주세요 kukumbira munhu kuti adzokorore.

korean-k2-l9.title: Zvinodiwa nemhinduro
korean-k2-l9.concept: 좋아요 zvinoreva zvakanaka kana zvakakwana, 싫어요 zvinoreva kuti haudi, 맞아요 zvinoreva “zvakarurama” uye 틀려요 zvinoreva “hazvina kururama”.

korean-k3-l1.title: Ndiri mudzidzi
korean-k3-l1.concept: **저는** zvinoreva “ini” (nekuremekedza). Isa **이에요** mushure mechinyararo uye **예요** mushure menzvovera kuti utaure kuti “Ndiri …”.

korean-k3-l10.title: Kutumira shoko kushamwari
korean-k3-l10.concept: Mashoko anotumirwa anoshandisa mitsara mipfupi yekuremekedza inopera ne **-요**. **지금 어디예요?** inobvunza kuti uri kupi, **곧 가요** zvinoreva kuti “Ndiri kuuya nokukurumidza” uye **늦어요** zvinoreva kuti “Ndanonoka”.
korean-k3-l10.example: 지금 어디예요? (jigeum eodiyeyo?) = Uri kupi izvozvi? / 곧 가요. (got gayo.) = Ndiri kuuya nokukurumidza.

korean-k3-l11.title: Kuverenga mazwi nenzwi guru
korean-k3-l11.concept: Kana silabheri inopera nechinyararo uye inotevera inotanga nenzvovera, inzwi rinoenda: 책이 rinoverengwa **chaegi** uye 밥을 rinoverengwa **babeul**. Mamwe manzwi anoshandura avo ari padyo: 국물 rinoverengwa **gungmul** uye 같이 rinoverengwa **gachi**.

korean-k3-l2.title: Mhuri yangu
korean-k3-l2.concept: Mazwi emhuri anoshandiswa zvakanyanya muchiKorea, kunyange kune vanhu vasiri mhuri.

korean-k3-l3.title: Kuverenga
korean-k3-l3.concept: ChiKorea chine marudzi maviri enhamba: eKorea chaiyo (하나, 둘, 셋 …) yekuverenga zvinhu, neSino-Korea (일, 이, 삼 …) yemari, mazuva nemaminitsi.

korean-k3-l4.title: Nhamba dzechiKorea chaicho 6–10
korean-k3-l4.concept: Enderera nenhamba dzechiKorea chaicho: 여섯 (6), 일곱 (7), 여덟 (8), 아홉 (9), 열 (10).
korean-k3-l4.example: 여섯 · 일곱 · 여덟 · 아홉 · 열 (yeoseot · ilgop · yeodeol · ahop · yeol)

korean-k3-l5.title: Nhamba dzeSino-Korea
korean-k3-l5.concept: Nhamba dzeSino-Korea: 일 (1), 이 (2), 삼 (3), 사 (4), 오 (5), 육 (6), 칠 (7), 팔 (8), 구 (9), 십 (10). Dzinoshandiswa pamari, mazuva, nhamba dzerunhare nemaminitsi.
korean-k3-l5.example: 일 · 이 · 삼 · 사 · 오 · 육 · 칠 · 팔 · 구 · 십 (il · i · sam · sa · o · yuk · chil · pal · gu · sip)

korean-k3-l6.title: Zera
korean-k3-l6.concept: Bvunzai 몇 살이에요? (Mune makore mangani?). Zera rinoshandisa nhamba dzechiKorea chaicho pamwe chete ne살: 열 살 (makore 10), 스무 살 (20), 서른 살 (30).
korean-k3-l6.example: 몇 살이에요? (myeot sarieyo?) = Mune makore mangani?

korean-k3-l8.title: Mamwe mazwi emhuri
korean-k3-l8.concept: Vanin'ina nehanzvadzi vanoshandisa mazwi akasiyana zvichienderana nemunhu anotaura: mukadzi anoti 오빠 (mukoma) uye 언니 (hanzvadzi huru). Zvakare 아들 (mwanakomana), 딸 (mwanasikana), 부모님 (vabereki).
korean-k3-l8.example: 오빠 (oppa) = mukoma (inotaurwa nemukadzi) / 언니 (eonni) = hanzvadzi huru (inotaurwa nemukadzi)

korean-k3-l9.title: Mhuri yedu
korean-k3-l9.concept: VaKorea vanowanzotaura 우리 (isu, wedu) pachinzvimbo che“wangu”: 우리 가족 zvinoreva “mhuri yangu”. Verengai vanhu ne명: 네 명 (vanhu vana).

korean-k4-l1.title: Zviito zvezuva nezuva
korean-k4-l1.concept: Zviito zvenguva yazvino zvine rukudzo zvinopera ne**-아요 / -어요 / -해요**. Chimiro chimwe chete chinoshandiswa pa“ini”, “iwe” ne“ivo”.

korean-k4-l2.title: Kuenda kunzvimbo
korean-k4-l2.concept: Isai **에** mushure menzvimbo kuti mutaure kwamunoenda kana kwamunouya: 학교에 가요. Chiito chinouya pakupedzisira.

korean-k4-l3.title: Kudya, kunwa, kuverenga
korean-k4-l3.concept: Chinhu chechiito chinowana **을** mushure mevara rakasimba uye **를** mushure menzwi: 밥을 먹어요, 커피를 마셔요.

korean-k4-l4.title: Chikafu nezvinwiwa
korean-k4-l4.concept: 밥 (mupunga, chikafu), 빵 (chingwa), 과일 (muchero), 고기 (nyama), 물 (mvura), 우유 (mukaka).

korean-k4-l5.title: Zvaunoda nezvausingadi
korean-k4-l5.concept: Taura zvaunoda ne-를/을 좋아해요 uye zvausingadi ne-를/을 싫어해요: 저는 사과를 좋아해요.

korean-k4-l6.title: Kutsanangura zvinhu
korean-k4-l6.concept: Mazwi ekutsanangura anopera ne-요 zvakare: 커요 (hombe), 작아요 (diki), 많아요 (zvakawanda), 맛있어요 (zvinonaka), 예뻐요 (zvakanaka).

korean-k4-l7.title: Mamiriro ekunze
korean-k4-l7.concept: 날씨 (mamiriro ekunze), 더워요 (kunopisa), 추워요 (kunotonhora), 비가 와요 (mvura iri kunaya), 눈이 와요 (chando chiri kunaya).

korean-k4-l8.title: Kutaura kuramba ne안 ne못
korean-k4-l8.concept: Isa **안** pamberi pechiito kutaura kuti hauiti chimwe chinhu (안 가요). Isa **못** pamberi pacho kutaura kuti hauzogoni (못 가요).

korean-k4-l9.title: Zvinoitwa zuva nezuva
korean-k4-l9.concept: 일어나요 (kumuka), 씻어요 (kugeza), 일해요 (kushanda), 자요 (kurara). Mazwi enguva akadai se아침 (mangwanani) ne밤 (usiku) anotora 에: 아침에.

korean-k5-l1.title: Nezuro, nhasi, mangwana
korean-k5-l1.concept: Mazwi enguva anowanzouya padyo nekutanga kwemutsara.

korean-k5-l2.title: Zvandakaita
korean-k5-l2.concept: Nguva yakapfuura: **-았어요 / -었어요 / -했어요**. Zvimwe zviito zvinopfupikiswa: 가다 → 갔어요, 보다 → 봤어요.

korean-k5-l3.title: Zvandichaita
korean-k5-l3.concept: Shandisa **-(으)ㄹ 거예요** pamapurani: 가다 → 갈 거예요, 먹다 → 먹을 거예요.
korean-k5-l3.example: 내일 갈 거예요. (naeil gal geoyeyo.) = Ndichaenda mangwana.

korean-k5-l4.title: Mazuva eVhiki
korean-k5-l4.concept: 월요일 (Muvhuro), 화요일 (Chipiri), 수요일 (Chitatu), 목요일 (China), 금요일 (Chishanu), 토요일 (Mugovera), 일요일 (Svondo).

korean-k5-l5.title: Mwedzi
korean-k5-l5.concept: Mwedzi inoumbwa nenhamba yeSino-Korean pamwe chete ne월: 일월 (Ndira), 삼월 (Kurume), 오월 (Chivabvu), 칠월 (Chikunguru), 구월 (Gunyana), 십이월 (Zvita).

korean-k5-l6.title: Kutaura nguva yeawa
korean-k5-l6.concept: Maawa anoshandisa nhamba dzechiKorea chaicho pamwe chete ne시: 한 시 (1:00), 두 시 (2:00), 세 시 (3:00), 열 시 (10:00). Bvunzai 몇 시예요?
korean-k5-l6.example: 한 시 · 두 시 · 세 시 (han si · du si · se si)

korean-k5-l7.title: Kangani
korean-k5-l7.concept: 매일 (zuva rega rega), 자주 (kazhinji), 가끔 (dzimwe nguva), 항상 (nguva dzose). Dzisei pamberi pechiito.
korean-k5-l7.example: 매일 (maeil) = zuva rega rega / 가끔 (gakkeum) = dzimwe nguva

korean-k5-l8.title: Nguva yakapfuura yakawanda
korean-k5-l8.concept: Chipetwa chenguva yakapfuura ndi-았/었어요: 했어요 (akaita), 왔어요 (akauya), 만났어요 (akasangana), 샀어요 (akatenga), 잤어요 (akarara).

korean-k5-l9.title: Mazuva ekuzvarwa nemigumisiro yevhiki
korean-k5-l9.concept: 생일 (zuva rekuzvarwa), 주말 (mugumisiro wevhiki), 선물 (chipo). Bvunzai 생일이 언제예요? uye mupindure 제 생일은 오월이에요.
korean-k5-l9.example: 생일이 언제예요? (saengiri eonjeyeyo?) = Zuva rako rekuzvarwa riri riini?

korean-k6-l1.title: Muchitoro
korean-k6-l1.concept: Bvunzai mutengo ne얼마예요? uye kumbirai chimwe chinhu ne**… 주세요** (… ndapota).

korean-k6-l2.title: Chiri kupi?
korean-k6-l2.concept: Bvunzai **… 어디예요?** (… riri kupi?). Teererai 오른쪽 (kurudyi), 왼쪽 (kuruboshwe) ne직진 (zvakananga).
korean-k6-l2.example: 화장실이 어디예요? (hwajangsiri eodiyeyo?) = Chimbuzi chiri kupi?

korean-k6-l3.title: Ndinoda kuita …
korean-k6-l3.concept: Wedzerai **-고 싶어요** pamudzi wechiito kutaura zvamunoda kuita: 가다 → 가고 싶어요.

korean-k6-l4.title: Muresitorendi
korean-k6-l4.concept: 메뉴 (menyu), 주문할게요 (ndichaodha), 물 더 주세요 (mvura yakawanda, ndapota), 계산해 주세요 (bhiri, ndapota).

korean-k6-l5.title: Kufamba-famba
korean-k6-l5.concept: 버스 (bhazi), 지하철 (chitima chepasi pevhu), 택시 (tekisi), 기차 (chitima). Taurai kuti munofamba sei ne-로/으로: 버스로 가요.
korean-k6-l5.example: 버스 (beoseu) = bhazi / 지하철 (jihacheol) = chitima chepasi pevhu

korean-k6-l6.title: Kufona nemameseji
korean-k6-l6.concept: 전화 (kufona), 전화번호 (nhamba yerunhare), 문자 (meseji). 전화해요 zvinoreva “Ndinofona”.

korean-k6-l7.title: Kuchipatara
korean-k6-l7.concept: 병원 (chipatara), 약 (mushonga), 아파요 (zvinorwadza). Taurai nhengo yemuviri kutanga: 머리가 아파요 (musoro wangu unorwadza).

korean-k6-l8.title: Zvikumbiro zvine chikokiso
korean-k6-l8.concept: -세요 ne-아/어 주세요 zvinoita zvikumbiro zvine chikokiso: 앉으세요 (ndapota gara pasi), 기다려 주세요 (ndapota mirira), 문을 열어 주세요 (ndapota vhura musuwo).

korean-k6-l9.title: Kuronga pamwe chete
korean-k6-l9.concept: 같이 (pamwe chete) inokoka munhu: 같이 가요. 갈래요? inobvunza “Unoda kuenda here?” uye 시간 있어요? inobvunza “Une nguva here?”
korean-k6-l9.example: 같이 가요. (gachi gayo.) = Ngatiende pamwe chete.

korean-k7-l1.title: Zvipeto zvine chikokiso zvepamutemo
korean-k7-l1.concept: Mumutauro wepamutemo nebasa, wedzera -ㅂ니다 pasina rechiito kana chipauro rinopera nenzvovera uye -습니다 pasina rinopera nebumbiro. Mibvunzo inopera ne-ㅂ니까 / -습니까.
korean-k7-l1.example: 저는 학생입니다. (jeoneun haksaengimnida.) = Ndiri mudzidzi. / 이름이 무엇입니까? (ireumi mueosimnikka?) = Zita renyu ndiani?

korean-k7-l10.title: Chiyero nekusadzivisika (-을수록, -기 마련이다)
korean-k7-l10.example: 만날수록 좋아요. (mannalsurok joayo.) = zviri nani sezvatinosangana / 사람은 실수하기 마련이에요. (sarameun silsuhagi maryeonieyo.) = vanhu vanotadza

korean-k7-l11.title: Chitarisiko nemhedziso (-아/어 보이다, -는 모양이다)
korean-k7-l11.example: 행복해 보여요. (haengbokae boyeoyo.) = anotaridzika kufara / 비가 오는 모양이에요. (biga oneun moyangieyo.) = zvinoita sekuti mvura iri kunaya

korean-k7-l12.title: Kunyepedzera (-는 척하다)
korean-k7-l12.concept: Kunyepedzera kuita kana kuva chimwe chinhu: -(으)ㄴ/는 척하다.

korean-k7-l13.title: Kuzvidemba nezvisina kuitika (-(으)ㄹ 걸 그랬어요)
korean-k7-l13.example: 일찍 올 걸 그랬어요. (iljjik ol geol geuraesseoyo.) = ndaifanira kuuya nekukurumidza

korean-k7-l14.title: Kudzokorora kwese kweK7
korean-k7-l14.concept: Dzokorora mutauro usiri wakananga, zvinobatanidza zvakaomarara nemataurirwo ane hunyanzvi.
korean-k7-l14.example: 친구가 온다고 했어요. (chinguga ondago haesseoyo.) = shamwari yakati ichauya / 같이 밥 먹자고 했어요. (gachi bap meokjago haesseoyo.) = akakurudzira kuti tidye pamwe chete

korean-k7-l2.title: Mafomu akajairika
korean-k7-l2.concept: Maitiro akajairika (ekunyora) anopedza mitsara yekutaura ne-ㄴ다 / -는다 uye mitsara yenguva yakapfuura ne-았다 / -었다. Mafomu aya ndiwo hwaro hwekutaura zvakataurwa mumadzidzo anotevera.
korean-k7-l2.example: 나는 학교에 간다. (naneun hakgyoe ganda.) = Ndinoenda kuchikoro. / 동생은 책을 읽는다. (dongsaengeun chaegeul ingneunda.) = Munin'ina wangu anoverenga bhuku.

korean-k7-l3.title: Kutsanangura mazita
korean-k7-l3.concept: Chiito kana chipauro chinogona kutsanangura zita: -(으)ㄴ kuzvipauro nezviito zvakapfuura, -는 kuzviito zvazvino, -(으)ㄹ kuzviito zvemberi kana zvakarongwa, zvichiiswa pamberi pezita.
korean-k7-l3.example: 저는 맛있는 음식을 좋아해요. (jeoneun masinneun eumsigeul joahaeyo.) = Ndinoda chikafu chinonaka. / 예쁜 꽃을 샀어요. (yeppeun kkocheul sasseoyo.) = Ndakatenga maruva akanaka.

korean-k7-l4.title: Zvinobatanidza zvekutanga
korean-k7-l4.concept: Batanidza zvikamu zvemitsara miviri ne-아/어서 (chikonzero kana kutevedzana), -지만 (kupesana), -(으)니까 (chikonzero), -(으)면 (kana) ne-(으)려고 (kuitira).
korean-k7-l4.example: 피곤해서 일찍 잤어요. (pigonhaeseo iljjik jasseoyo.) = Ndakanga ndakaneta, saka ndakarara nekukurumidza. / 비가 와서 집에 있었어요. (biga waseo jibe isseosseoyo.) = Mvura yakanaya, saka ndakagara kumba.

korean-k7-l5.title: Kugona, mutoro, mvumo
korean-k7-l5.concept: -(으)ㄹ 수 있다/없다 inoratidza kugona kana mukana, -아/어야 하다 mutoro, uye -아/어도 되다 mvumo.
korean-k7-l5.example: 저는 수영할 수 있어요. (jeoneun suyeonghal su isseoyo.) = Ndinogona kushambira. / 저는 한국어로 이야기할 수 있어요. (jeoneun hangugeoro iyagihal su isseoyo.) = Ndinogona kutaura muchiKorean.

korean-k7-l6.title: Mitsara isiri yakananga (-다고 하다)
korean-k7-l6.concept: Zivisa zvinotaurwa kana zvakataurwa nemumwe munhu: chiito/chipauro + -다고 하다.
korean-k7-l6.example: 친구가 온다고 해요. (chinguga ondago haeyo.) = shamwari yakati ichauya

korean-k7-l7.title: Mibvunzo isiri yakananga (-냐고 하다)
korean-k7-l7.example: 어디 가냐고 물었어요. (eodi ganyago mureosseoyo.) = akabvunza kuti ari kuenda kupi

korean-k7-l8.title: Mirairo nezvikumbiro zvisiri zvakananga (-라고 / -자고 하다)
korean-k7-l8.concept: Zivisa murairo (-라고 하다) kana zvikumbiro zvekuita pamwe chete (-자고 하다).
korean-k7-l8.example: 빨리 오라고 했어요. (ppalli orago haesseoyo.) = akaudzwa kuti auye nekukurumidza / 같이 가자고 했어요. (gachi gajago haesseoyo.) = akakurudzira kuti tiende pamwe chete

korean-k7-l9.title: Zvikonzero zvakaoma nekusiyanisa (-느라고, -는데도)
korean-k7-l9.concept: Chikonzero chakaipa kana kunonoka (-느라고) nekusiyanisa kunyangwe zvichidaro (-는데도).
korean-k7-l9.example: 공부하느라고 바빴어요. (gongbuhaneurago bapasseoyo.) = ndakanga ndakabatikana nekudzidza / 비가 오는데도 갔어요. (biga oneundedo gasseoyo.) = akaenda kunyange mvura ichinaya

korean-k8-l1.title: Mazwi ekukudza evanotaurwa nezvavo
korean-k8-l1.concept: Mazita nezviito zvakasarudzika zvekukudza vanhu vanokudzwa: 진지, 주무시다, 편찮으시다.
korean-k8-l1.example: 할머니께서 진지를 드세요. (halmeonikkeseo jinjireul deuseyo.) = ambuya vari kudya chikafu

korean-k8-l2.title: Zviito zvekukudza zvinotarisa kuchinhu (드리다, 뵙다, 여쭙다)
korean-k8-l2.concept: Zviito zvekuzvininipisa/zvekukudza kana chiito chakananga kumukuru: 드리다, 뵙다, 여쭙다.
korean-k8-l2.example: 선물을 드려요. (seonmureul deuryeoyo.) = ndinopa chipo nerukudzo / 내일 봬요. (naeil bwaeyo.) = tichaonana mangwana nerukudzo

korean-k8-l3.title: Zviito zvinoitirwa zvine zvipetwa (-이/히/리/기-)
korean-k8-l3.concept: Zviito zvinoitirwa zvinogadzirwa nekuwedzera -이/히/리/기-: 보이다, 들리다, 열리다, 닫히다.
korean-k8-l3.example: 문이 열려요. (muni yeollyeoyo.) = musuwo unovhurika / 창문이 닫혀요. (changmuni dachyeoyo.) = hwindo rinovharika

korean-k8-l4.title: Zviito zvinoitirwa zvemushoko (-어지다, -게 되다)
korean-k8-l4.concept: Zviito zvinotora mafomu ekuitika pachezvazvo kana mugumisiro: -아/어지다, -게 되다.
korean-k8-l4.example: 글씨가 써져요. (geulssiga sseojyeoyo.) = zvinyorwa zvinonyorwa zvakanaka / 알게 되었어요. (alge doeeosseoyo.) = ndakazotanga kuziva

korean-k8-l5.title: Zviito zvekuita kuti vamwe vaite zvine zvipetwa (-이/히/리/기/우-)
korean-k8-l5.concept: Zviito zvinoita kuti munhu aite chiito: 보여 주다, 먹이다, 입히다.
korean-k8-l5.example: 사진을 보여 줘요. (sajineul boyeo jwoyo.) = anoratidza mufananidzo / 아기에게 밥을 먹여요. (agiege babeul meogyeoyo.) = anopa mwana chikafu

korean-k8-l6.title: Zviito zvekuita kuti vamwe vaite zvemushoko (-게 하다)
korean-k8-l6.concept: Kuita kuti munhu aite chimwe chinhu: -게 하다.
korean-k8-l6.example: 웃게 해요. (utge haeyo.) = anoita kuti vaseke / 기다리게 했어요. (gidarige haesseoyo.) = akaita kuti vamirire

korean-k8-l7.title: Maitiro ezviri pamutemo pachena (-하십시오)
korean-k8-l7.example: 자리에 앉으십시오. (jarie anjeusipsio.) = ndapota garai pasi / 출발하십시다. (chulbalhasipsida.) = ngatiendei

korean-k8-l8.title: Mataurirwo ekuzvininipisa nekuzvidzikisa
korean-k8-l8.concept: Kutaura nerukudzo uchishandisa zvirevo nezviito zvekuzvininipisa: 저희, 말씀 올리다.
korean-k8-l8.example: 인사 말씀 올립니다. (insa malsseum ollimnida.) = ndinopa mashoko ekukwazisa / 저희 학교입니다. (jeohui hakgyoimnida.) = chikoro chedu nekuzvininipisa

korean-k8-l9.title: K8 Ongororo Yakazara
korean-k8-l9.concept: Ongorora hunhu hwekukudza, passive, causative nemhando dzekukudza dzepamutemo.
korean-k8-l9.example: 할머니께 선물을 드렸어요. (halmeonikke seonmureul deuryeosseoyo.) = kupa ambuya chipo / 문이 저절로 닫혔어요. (muni jeojeollo dachyeosseoyo.) = musuwo wakazvivhara

korean-k9-l1.title: Kunyora email yebhizimisi nekukumbira
korean-k9-l1.concept: Tsika dzemaemail ebhizimisi epamutemo: -에 관하여, 검토 부탁드립니다.
korean-k9-l1.example: 회의 안건에 관하여 말씀드립니다. (hoeui angeone gwanhayeo malsseumdeurimnida.) = nezvemusangano wemagakava

korean-k9-l2.title: Tsika dzerunhare dzebhizimisi
korean-k9-l2.concept: Kubata kudaidza nemameseji: 통화 가능하신지요, 연결해 드리겠습니다.
korean-k9-l2.example: 지금 통화 가능하신지요? (jigeum tonghwa ganeunghasinjiyo?) = ndinogona kutaura zvino / 담당자를 연결해 드리겠습니다. (damdangjareul yeongyeolhae deurigetseumnida.) = ndichakubatanidzai nemunhu anotarisira

korean-k9-l3.title: Kurongera nekuchinja nguva
korean-k9-l3.concept: Kukurudzira nekushandura nguva dzekusangana: 변경하고자 합니다, 양해 부탁드립니다.
korean-k9-l3.example: 일정을 변경하고자 합니다. (iljeongeul byeongyeonghagoja hamnida.) = chikumbiro chekushandura hurongwa / 너른 양해 부탁드립니다. (neoreun yanghae butakdeurimnida.) = kukumbira kunzwisiswa

korean-k9-l4.title: Nhaurirano nepfungwa mumisangano
korean-k9-l4.concept: Kutaura pfungwa mumisangano: 제 생각으로는, 찬성합니다, 추가 검토.
korean-k9-l4.example: 제 생각으로는 이번 안이 좋습니다. (je saenggakeoroneun ibeon ani jotseumnida.) = pandinofunga, chikumbiro ichi chakanaka / 적극 찬성합니다. (jeokgeuk chanseonghamnida.) = ndinobvumirana nazvo zvikuru

korean-k9-l5.title: Kureporta kufambira mberi kweprojekiti
korean-k9-l5.concept: Kupa ruzivo rwemamiriro: 진행 상황을 보고합니다, 조치를 완료했습니다.
korean-k9-l5.example: 프로젝트 진행 상황을 보고합니다. (peurojekteu jinhaeng sanghwangeul bogohamnida.) = ndiri kureporta kufambira mberi kweprojekiti / 조치를 완료했습니다. (jochireul wallyohaesseumnida.) = danho rapedzwa

korean-k9-l6.title: Nhamba dzehuwandu nemafambiro edata
korean-k9-l6.concept: Kuratidza mafambiro nenhamba: 증가했습니다, 전년 대비.
korean-k9-l6.example: 매출이 증가했습니다. (maechuri jeunggahaesseumnida.) = kutengesa kwakawedzera / 전년 대비 상승했습니다. (jeonnyeon daebi sangseunghaesseumnida.) = kwakawedzera kuchienzaniswa negore rapfuura

korean-k9-l7.title: Kutaurirana kwebhizimisi nekubatana
korean-k9-l7.concept: Kushanda pamwe pamutemo: 상호 협력을 희망합니다, 절충안 제시.
korean-k9-l7.example: 상호 협력을 희망합니다. (sangho hyeomnyeogeul huimanghamnida.) = tinovavarira kushanda pamwe / 절충안을 제안합니다. (jeolchuganeul jeanhamnida.) = ndinokurudzira nzira yepakati

korean-k9-l8.title: Makadhi ebhizimisi nemazita ebasa
korean-k9-l8.concept: Kuchinjana makadhi nemazita: 처음 뵙겠습니다, 명함 드립니다.
korean-k9-l8.example: 처음 뵙겠습니다, 명함 드립니다. (cheoeum boepgetseumnida, myeongham deurimnida.) = ndafara kukusangana, ndinokupai kadhi / 김 부장님입니다. (gim bujangnimimnida.) = maneja wechikamu Kim

korean-k9-l9.title: Kudzokorora kwese kweK9
korean-k9-l9.concept: Dzokorora kutaurirana kwebasa, tsamba dzepamutemo nemisangano.
korean-k9-l9.example: 안건을 검토해 주시기 바랍니다. (angeoneul geomtohae jusigi baramnida.) = ndapota ongororai ajenda / 회의에서 뵙겠습니다. (hoeuieseo boepgetseumnida.) = tichaonana mumusangano

texts.n:k.k3.ages:ageN: Zera rinoverengwa nenhamba dzepachisikigo dzinotevedzerwa nechiverengo chemakore; makumi maviri anotora chimiro chipfupi chakasiyana pamberi pacho.
texts.n:k.k3.ages:ageQ: Kubvunza zera romunhu, izwi rekubvunza 'zvingani' rinobatanidzwa nechiverengo chemakore.
texts.n:k.k3.ages:tens: Makumi epachisikigo (makumi matatu, makumi mana, makumi mashanu, nezvimwe) mazwi akazvimirira uye anobatana zvakananga nenhamba yeumwe.

texts.n:k.k3.family:topicP: Chikamu chenyaya chine mafomu maviri: rimwe rinoshandiswa mushure mezita rinopera nechinyararo, rimwe mushure mezita rinopera nenzvovera.
texts.n:k.k3.family:objP: Chikamu chechinhu chine mafomu maviri zvichienderana nokuti zita rinopera nenzvovera kana nechinyararo.
texts.n:k.k3.family:possP: Chikamu chekuva muridzi chinobatanidza mazita maviri, senge 's muchiRungu.
texts.n:k.k3.family:countP: Kuverenga vanhu, nhamba yepachisikigo inoiswa pamberi pechiverengo chevanhu.
texts.g:299a0736: Ndinodya chikafu pamwe chete nemhuri yangu.
texts.n:k.k3.family2:who: Vanun'una nehanzvadzi vane mazwi akasiyana zvichienderana nokuti mutauri murume kana mukadzi, uye nokuti munun'una kana hanzvadzi yacho yakura kana diki.
texts.n:k.k3.family2:side: Madzitete namaamai vanoshandisa mazwi akasiyana zvichienderana nekuti vari kumativi ababa here kana amai.
texts.n:k.k3.family2:topicP: Chidimbu chenyaya chine mhando mbiri: imwe inoshandiswa mushure mezita rinopera nevara rinoperera, imwe mushure mezita rinoperera nevara rinorira.
texts.n:k.k3.family2:countP: Kuverenga vanhu, nhamba yechiKorea yepakutanga inouya pamberi pechiverengero chevanhu, uye imwe inopfupikiswa pamberi pacho.
texts.g:8ec16e71: Ndine hanzvadzi dzakuru mbiri (murume ari kutaura).
texts.n:k.k3.messages:ask: Mibvunzo yakaita se 'chii', 'kupi' ne 'nguva ipi' inotsiva chikamu chisingazivikanwe uye kurongeka kwemazwi kunoramba kwakadaro.
texts.n:k.k3.messages:loc: Izwi renzvimbo rinoteverwa nechidimbu chenzvimbo rinoratidza kwaari munhu kana kwaari kuenda.
texts.n:k.k3.messages:past: Magumo enguva yakapfuura anoratidza kuti chimwe chinhu chakatoitika.

texts.n:k.k3.native10:nat6: Nhamba dzepakutanga dzechiKorea kubva pa 6 kusvika pa 10 dzinoramba dziine chimiro chimwe pamberi pechiverengero, kusiyana ne 1 kusvika ne 4.
texts.n:k.k3.native10:hour: Maawa anoverengwa nenhamba dzepakutanga, asi maminetsi anoverengwa nenhamba dzeSino-Korean.
texts.n:k.k3.native10:ordN: Chidimbu chinowedzerwa panhamba yepakutanga chinoiita nhamba yekutevedzana, sa 'th' muchiRungu.
texts.n:k.k3.native10:ctr: Izwi rimwe nerimwe rechiverengero (vanhu, makapu, mhuka, mabhodhoro, mabhuku, zvidimbu) rinotevera nhamba.

texts.n:k.k3.numbers:nat: Nhamba dzepakutanga dzechiKorea dzinoverenga zvinhu nevanhu; imwe, mbiri, tatu nenhamba china dzinochinja chimiro pamberi pechiverengero.
texts.n:k.k3.numbers:sinoN: Nhamba dzeSino-Korean dzinoshandiswa pamasuru, mwedzi, nhamba dzenzira nemasvomhu.
texts.n:k.k3.numbers:ctr: Izwi rimwe nerimwe rechiverengero (makapu, mabhuku, mhuka, mabhodhoro, vanhu) rinoiswa shure kwenhamba nezita.
texts.n:k.k3.numbers:mathN: Mumasvomhu, nhamba dzeSino-Korean dzinoshandiswa uye mhinduro inoteverwa necopula.

texts.n:k.k3.ourfamily:famN: Kuti utaure huwandu hwenhengo dzemhuri, nhamba yepakutanga inouya pamberi pechiverengero chevanhu.
texts.n:k.k3.ourfamily:birth: Mazwi ekutevedzana kwekuberekwa anoratidza kuti munhu ari papi pakati pevana vemhuri.
texts.n:k.k3.ourfamily:ask: Izwi rekubvunza rinoreva 'vangani' rinouya pamberi pechiverengero chevanhu.

texts.n:k.k3.people:dem: Izwi rekuratidza rinoiswa pamberi pezita rinoratidza munhu kana chinhu chiri kure nevanotaura vose vari vaviri.
texts.n:k.k3.people:cnt: Kuverenga vanhu, nhamba yechiKorea yepakutanga inouya pamberi pechiverengero chevanhu.
texts.n:k.k3.people:occ: Mazita ebasa mazita, saka anotora copula kuti utaure zvinoitwa nemunhu.
texts.n:k.k3.self:copula: Kuti utaure 'Ndiri ...', zita rinoteverwa necopula ine chimiro chinoenderana nekuti zita rinopera nevara rinorira kana rinoperera.
texts.n:k.k3.self:negCop: Kuti utaure 'haasi', zita rinotora chidimbu chechirevo uye rinoteverwa necopula yekuramba yakasiyana.
texts.n:k.k3.self:alsoP: Chidimbu chinoreva 'zvakare' chinotora nzvimbo yechidimbu chenyaya.
texts.n:k.k3.self:natQ: Mazwi ekubvunza akaita se 'chii', 'ani' ne 'ipi' anotsiva chikamu chisingazivikanwe chemutsara; kurongeka kwemazwi kunoramba kwakadaro.
texts.s:c790431f: Wangobva kuziviswa kumunhu kekutanga uye unoda kutaura kuti unofara kusangana naye.
texts.n:k.k3.sino:money: Mitengo inotaurwa nenhamba yeSino-Korean inoteverwa neizwi remari; gumi ramazana (10,000) rine chikamu charo pamusoro pezviuru.
texts.n:k.k3.sino:irrMonth: Mazita maviri emwedzi anochinja kuperetwa kwawo: muzvose zviviri, nhamba inosiya vara rayo rekupedzisira pamberi peizwi remwedzi.
texts.n:k.k3.sino:mathS: Masvomhu nenhamba dzerunhare dzinoverengwa nenhamba dzeSino-Korean, uye mhinduro inoteverwa necopula.
texts.n:k.k3.sino:dateS: Mazuva anotaurwa semwedzi, wozoteverwa nezuva, achishandisa nhamba dzeSino-Korean nezvikamu zvemwedzi nezuva.
texts.n:k.k3.sino:bigN: Nhamba huru dzeSino-Korean dzinovakwa kubva pamagumi, mazana nezviuru zvichiverengwa kubva kuruboshwe kuenda kurudyi.
texts.g:ace273d9: Nhamba yangu yerunhare ndeye zero-poshi-zero, piri-tatu-china-shanu, tanhatu-nomwe-sere-pfumbamwe.
texts.n:k.k3.sounds:linkC: Vara rinoperera rinokwidzira kusilabheri inotevera kana silabheri iyoyo ichitanga nevara risingarire, saka rinonzwika sekubatana.

texts.n:k.k5.months:moA: Mazita emwedzi inhamba dzeSino-Korea pamwe neizwi rinoreva mwedzi; maviri awo anonyorwa nechinyararo chekupedzisira chakasiiwa.
texts.n:k.k5.months:moB: Mazuva anoverengwa mwedzi kutanga, ipapo zuva, uye zvikamu zvose zviri zviviri zvinoshandisa nhamba dzeSino-Korea.
texts.n:k.k5.months:moC: Mazwi ekwakaberekwa kwegore anotora chikamu chenguva chinoreva 'mu', kazhinji nechiratidzo chenyaya chakawedzerwa.
texts.n:k.k5.past:pastA: Nguva yakapfuura inoumbwa nekuwedzera chiperengo kumudzi wechiito; nzvovera yechiperengo inoenderana nenzvovera yekupedzisira yemudzi, uye zviito zve'kuita' zvinoshandisa fomu yakakosha.
texts.n:k.k5.past:pastB: Zvivakazve zvinotora zviperengo zvinofanana nezviito zvenguva yakapfuura uye zvinotsanangura kuti chinhu chaiva sei.
texts.g:c60ae8ca: Ndaiva nebasa guru kwazvo vhiki rapfuura.
texts.g:4f846d8d: Munun'una kana hanzvadzi yangu yakanatsa imba.
texts.g:bab3b20d: Ndakadya chikafu chemanheru nemhuri yangu nezuro.
texts.g:1673a728:

B: Ndakasangana neshamwari. Uye ndakatarisa firimu.
texts.g:ea765dea:

B: Ndakazorora pamba. Uye ndakaverenga bhuku.
texts.g:82cb09ee: Mugovera wapfuura takabika chikafu chemanheru pamwe chete kumba kweshamwari.
texts.g:40862514: Ndakaita basa reimba husiku hwapfuura, saka ndakaneta mangwanani.
texts.g:bf51d517: Minji, ndine hurombo kuti ndakatadza kuenda kumusangano nezuro. Ndakanga ndine musoro unorwadza kubva mangwanani. Ndakatora mushonga ndikazorora kumba. Ndiri zvakanaka zvino.
texts.g:83bfe9ee:
A: Wakaenda kupi mukupera kwevhiki?
B: Ndakaenda kugungwa. Ndakatorawo mapikicha mazhinji.
A: Mamiriro ekunze akanga akadini?
B: Aitonhorera zvishoma, asi akanaka kwazvo.

texts.n:k.k5.past2:p2B: Chiito 'kuva' chine mafomu azvo enguva yakapfuura anoenderana nekuti zita rinopera nebumbiro kana nzvovera.
texts.n:k.k5.past2:p2C: Izwi rinoramba rakaiswa pamberi pechiito rinopa 'handina' kana 'handina kugona', uye chiito pachacho chinotakura chipeto chenguva yakapfuura.

texts.g:f567fa5f: Ndiri kuzivisa mamiriro ekubata mibvunzo yevatengi yekota yechitatu. Mibvunzo yose yaisvika 2,400, kukwira ne8 muzana kubva pakota yakapfuura, asi nguva yepakati yekubata yakapfupikiswa kubva pamazuva maviri kusvika paimwe. Izvi zvinoongororwa semugumisiro wekudzikira kwemibvunzo iri nyore mushure mekurongedza mibvunzo inowanzobvunzwa pamapeji eruzivo. Zvisinei, mibvunzo ine chekuita nekudzorerwa kwemari yakawedzera, saka hurongwa hwakasiyana hwekupindura hunodiwa. Mukota yechina tinoronga kutanga kuvandudza kutungamirirwa kwemaitiro ekudzorerwa kwemari.
texts.g:85123a65: Maminitsi emusangano wechitatu wekuongorora purojekiti. Nyaya yaiva kuronga zvakare nguva yekutsiva hurongwa hwemhepo hwechivako chehofisi. Mukupindura, maneja weKutarisira akagamuchira kunonoka kwakatarisirana nepfungwa yekuti basa richapera kuongororwa kwegore kusati kwasvika, asi akasarudza kuti kana zuva rekupedza rakatarisirwa ritamburira zvakare, maitiro ekusarudza mukontirakita wekutsiva achatanga nekukurumidza. Nhengo dzakabvumirana kuzivisa mukontirakita nezvemamiriro aya nekunyora. Zvisinei, kuti ndiani ane mhosva yekunonoka kwekusvika kwezvikamu hakuna kutaurwa musangano uyu.
texts.g:bb2fd3a9: Chiziviso chemitengo yakagadziridzwa yekumisa mota munzvimbo dzose. Kubva pa1 yemwedzi unotevera, mutengo wekutanga uchagadziridzwa kubva pa600 won kusvika pa800 won pamaminitsi makumi matatu ega ega. Zvisinei, mutengo wekare uchashanda kumota dzakanyoreswa kuti dzivagari vane kutanga kumisa uye mota dzinoratidza mvumo yehurema. Kunyange kumota dzakanyoreswa, kana kushandiswa kwemwedzi kuchipfuura maawa zana, mutengo wakagadziridzwa unoshanda kune zvakapfuura chete. Mari yekuwedzera inobva pakugadziridza ichashandiswa chete pakugadzirisa zvivakwa, uye kushandiswa kwakadzama kwemari kuchaiswa pawebsite pakupera kwegore.
texts.g:049bc42e: Gwaro rekuongorora remukati. Mukuongorora sampuli yemakontirakiti makumi mana ekutenga zvinhu muhafu yekutanga yegore rino, makumi matatu nematanhatu akatevera maitiro. Mune mana akasara, chikonzero chekontirakiti isina tenda chakanyorwa mushure mekusainwa kwekontirakiti, asi nekuti huwandu hwemari hwemakontirakiti hwose hwakaderera pamusoro pemuganho, hazvitorwi semhosva dzemitemo. Zvisinei, kuti kunyora kwemushure kusava tsika, chikamu chine basa chinofanira kuvhimbisa chikonzero kontirakiti isati yasainwa kubva pakota inotevera. Chikwata chekuongorora chichatarisazve kutevera kwemitemo pakupera kwekota.
texts.g:976a9aaa: Muchidimbu chemaminitsi ekukurukurirana bhajeti yehafu yechipiri. Chikamu cheR&D chakakumbira kuwedzera kwemutengo wekutenga midziyo kwe400 miriyoni won. Komiti yemari haina kubvumira huwandu hwose hwakakumbirwa; yakatanga kugovera 200 miriyoni won ndokusarudza kufunga zvakasara zvakare chete kana chiyero chekushandiswa kwemidziyo chegore rino chikapfuura 70 muzana. Mutungamiriri akakumbira chikamu cheR&D kugadzirira, musangano unotevera usati wasvika, zvinodiwa zvekuverenga chiyero chekushandiswa. Chikamu cheR&D hachina kukwidza kupokana kwakati pamusoro peizvi.
texts.g:ae29c713: Mamiriro ekuedza kupfupisa nguva yekugadzirisa mvumo. Nguva yepakati yekugadzirisa yegore rino yaiva mazuva 41, mazuva 9 mashoma kupfuura gore rapfuura. Chipingaidzo munguva yekugadzirisa chichiri padanho rekubvunzana nezvemhedzisiro dzemamiriro enzvimbo, rinoumba 60 muzana yenyaya dzose dzakanonoka. Chikamu chine basa chichaedza nzira yekubata maitiro ekubvunzana panguva imwe chete, asi hachizopfupisi nguva yepamutemo yekuongorora. Nguva inowanikwa kubva pakubata panguva imwe chete inofanira kuwanikwa nekudzikisa kuti zvikumbiro zvekuwedzera magwaro ekukumbira zvinodzokororwa kangani. Saka mugumisiro wekupfupisa uchaenderana zvakanyanya nekuti magwaro anopiwa zvakakwana kubva pakutanga here.
texts.g:d3bd3f83: Gwaro pamusoro pemamiriro nematanho mushure mengozi yeforklift yakabata munhu panzvimbo yekugovera. Panguva yebasa rehusiku mwedzi wapfuura, forklift yakabata mushandi munzvimbo yekutakura, asi mushandi akangowana kukuvara kudiki kwekusimba. Ongororo yakawana kuti mutyairi akatevera kumhanya kwakatarwa uye mamiriro ekugadzirisa forklift akanga akanaka zvakare. Zvisinei, munzvimbo yakanga isina chiedza chakakwana nzira yevafambi netsoka neyemotokari hadzina kuparadzaniswa. Nzvimbo yakatonga kuti chikonzero chakananga chaiva kuremara kwehurongwa hwekufamba pane kusarega kwemunhu pachake, ndokusarudza kusarova mutyairi. Panzvimbo yeizvozvo, ichapedza kuparadzanisa nzira mukati memwedzi miviri uye, kusvikira panguva iyoyo, ichaganhurira basa rehusiku munzvimbo iyoyo.
texts.g:6c39236a: Maonero pamusoro pekufungidzirwa kuti zvinyorwa zvekupinda mudata zvakabuda. Hangyeol Institute yakazivisa kuti, maererano nekuongororwa nekambani yekunze yezvekuchengetedza, zviratidzo zvakasimbiswa zvekuti zvinyorwa zvekupinda zvevamwe vaongorori zvakatariswa kubva kunze muna Kurume wapfuura. Zvisinei, kuti zvinyorwa zvakatariswa zvaive neruzivo rwekuzivikanwa hazvisati zvasimbiswa, uye parizvino hapana mienzaniso yekukuvara yakagamuchirwa. Institute yakati ichaburitsa mhedzisiro pakarepo kuongorora kwapera uye, kana zvikaratidzwa kuti ruzivo rwekuzivikanwa rwakanga rwuri mukati, ichazivisa vanobatanidzwa mumwe nemumwe. Pamusoro pezvo, inorongera kuongorora kwakazara kwehurongwa hwekutonga mvumo yekupinda nekuda kwechiitiko ichi.
texts.g:b9e90e9f: Kuongororwa kwakawana zvimwe zvinhu zvakapfuura mwero, saka kwakakumbirwa danho rekugadzirisa.

texts.g:3359bae0: Tichishandisa kudzikira kwechikamu chemusika chemukwikwidzi, kutengesa kwechigadzirwa chedu kwakakura nekukurumidza.

texts.g:b6b6f2d4: Kukosha kwekutengesa kunze kwemwedzi wapfuura kwakakwira zvishoma kana tichienzanisa nemwedzi umwe chete wegore rapfuura, asi chiyero chekukura chakadzikira.
texts.g:9454f6f5: Kambani yakaongorora huwandu hwevashanyi mwedzi nemwedzi veshopu yayo yepaintaneti. Vashanyi vakakura zvishoma nezvishoma kubva muna Ndira kusvika Kurume asi vakadzikira kekutanga muna Kubvumbi. Munhu ane basa akaongorora kuti kuwedzera kwezvichemo zvekunonotswa kwekutakurwa ndiko kwakakonzera. Saka kambani yakasarudza kutanga nekugadzira nzira yekupfupisa nguva yekutakura.
texts.g:f7c5d0c2: Gwaro rekuongorora kugutsikana kwevatengi. Kugutsikana kwegore rino kwaiva mapoinzi 78, mana kupfuura 74 yegore rapfuura. Zvisinei, gore rino maitiro ekutora vanopindura akachinjwa kubva pa runhare kuenda paintaneti, uye chikamu chevanhu vemakore ma20 nema30 pakati pevanopindura vepaintaneti chakava kaviri chegore rapfuura. Boka rezera iri ndiro rakapa mapoinzi akakwirira kupfuura epakati muongororo dzakapfuura zvakare. Saka, kuti kukwira kwacho kunobva pakuvandudzwa chaiko kwebasa zvakaoma kutonga kubva padata razvino. Tinokurudzira kuti ongororo inotevera ienzanise nezvikamu zvezera zvakaenzanisirwa nezvegore rapfuura.
texts.g:e13c0f5b: Pfungwa dzekuongorora dzemigumisiro yehurongwa hwerubatsiro hwemabhizimisi madiki emuno. Kutengesa kwepakati kwemwedzi kwemabhizimisi makumi matatu akabatsirwa kwakakwira ne18 muzana kana tichienzanisa nekusati kwatanga hurongwa. Asi kana tichitarisa bhizimisi rimwe nerimwe, mabhizimisi maviri akaona kutengesa kuchikwira kupfuura katatu uye makumi maviri nerimwe akadzikira zvishoma. Kana maviri aya akabviswa, chiyero chepakati chekukwira chinodzikira zvakanyanya. Chikamu chinotarisira hurongwa chakapedzisa chichiti chakabudirira pamusoro pezvose, asi tichitarisa manhamba ari pamusoro, humbowo hunotsigira mhedziso iyoyo hahuzvikwani.
texts.g:700e4ddd: Gwaro pamusoro pekuchengetedzeka kwemigwagwa munzvimbo yehutongi. Ngozi dzemigwagwa dzegore rino dzaisvika 1,200, kukwira ne6 muzana kubva pagore rapfuura, asi huwandu hwemotokari dzakanyoreswa munguva imwe chete hwakakwira ne11 muzana. Kana dzashandurwa kuita ngozi pamotokari 10,000, dzakadzikira chaizvo. Zvisinei, kufa kuri pamwero mumwe chete negore rapfuura, saka zvakaoma kutaura kuti mugumisiro wemwero wengozi wakadzikira wakasvika pakudzikira kwengozi dzakakomba. Gwaro rinokurudzira kududzira zviratidzo zvehuwandu nezvehukuru hwengozi zvakasiyana.
texts.g:901fbaeb: Maererano nemushumo wesangano rekutsvagurudza, mumakore mashanu apfuura pakaonekwa tsika yekuti huwandu hwematsotsi evechidiki hunodzika mumaguta nemadhorobha apo maraibhurari akawedzera. Asi mushumo uhu hausvikiri mhedziso yekuti iyi ndiyo mhedzisiro yekuwedzera maraibhurari, uye unotaurawo nezvekuthekera kwekuti zvinhu zvose zviri zviviri zvine chekuita nemamiriro emari enzvimbo. Izvi zvinodaro nokuti nzvimbo dzine mari yakakwana dzakawedzera kwete maraibhurari bedzi asi zvirongwa zvemushure mechikoro zvakare. Sangano rakawedzera kuti kuti kusimbiswe mhedzisiro yakazvimirira yekuwedzera maraibhurari, nzvimbo dzine mamiriro emari akafanana dzinofanira kuenzaniswa.
texts.g:3ca56d36: Mhedzisiro yeongororo yemaonero evagari yapfupikiswa. Pachirongwa chiri kutaurwa, rutsigiro rwaiva 62 muzana, kupikisa 31 muzana, uye kusapindura 7 muzana. Asi, huwandu hwevakapindura hwaiva 4 muzana chete, uye vakapindura vane makore 65 kana kupfuura, ve52 muzana, vakapfuura zvikuru chikamu chavo chaicho chevanhu che24 muzana. Chikwata chekutsvagurudza chakaratidzawo nhamba dzakagadziriswa kuti zvikamu zvemakore zvienderane nemagadzirirwo echokwadi evanhu; mushure mekugadziriswa, rutsigiro rwakadzika kusvika ku54 muzana asi rwaiva rwuchiri pamusoro pekupikisa. Chikwata chakataura kuti nzira yekuti rutsigiro ruri pamberi inoramba, asi musiyano unofanira kududzirwa sediki kupfuura nhamba dzekutanga.
texts.g:98ee0f8a: Mushumo wemhedzisiro yekushanda yechikamu chechitatu. Purofiti yakachena yaiva 12 billion won, yakakwira nezvikamu 35 muzana kubva panguva imwechete gore rapfuura. Asi, 2.5 billion won yeiyi imhedzisiro yenguva imwe chete kubva pakutengesa chidimbu chivhu chisina kushandiswa. Kana chabviswa, huwandu hwekukura kwepurofiti yakachena hunoramba huri mudhijiti imwe. Uyewo, purofiti yekushanda, inoratidza purofiti kubva kubasa guru rekutengesa zvigadzirwa, yakadzika ne2 muzana. Chikwata chemari chinotonga kuti kuverenga kukwira kwepurofiti yakachena sechiratidzo chekuti bhizinesi riri kuvandudzika kwakakurumidza. Kuongororwa uku kuchaongororwazve mushure mekuona kana chimiro chimwechete chichidzokororwa chikamu chinotevera.
texts.g:67ee002c: Mushumo wemwedzi wemafambiro emusika wemba. Mwedzi uno huwandu hwekutengeswa kwemaapatimendi munzvimbo yeguta guru hwakawedzera ne3 muzana kubva mwedzi wapfuura, asi kana tichitarisa kuyerera kwemwedzi mitatu yapfuura chaizvo iri mukati menhanho isingachinji. Chiratidzo chemitengo chakawedzerawo ne0.2 muzana chete, izvo zvinogona kuonekwa sashanduko iri mukati mehuwandu hwekukanganisa. Panguva iyoyo, pane mishumo kubva kune indasitiri yevatengesi yekuti mibvunzo yakawedzera mushure mekudzikiswa kwemubayiro wechikwereti, asi izvi hazvisati zvasimbiswa mundhamba dzekutengesa. Naizvozvo mushumo uyu unotora maonero ekuti zvakakurumidza kutonga kuti musika wapinda munhanho yekudzoka.
texts.g:e7f9a5a1: Sangano rekutsvagurudza rakaongorora vashandi vemahofisi 1,200: vakapindura vanoshanda vari kumba kanokwana kaviri nevhiki vakazivisa kugutsikana kwebasa kwepakati kwemapoinzi 78, kwakakwirira kupfuura 65 evashandi vemahofisi. Pachinhu ichi sangano rakazivisa kuti kushanda uri kumba kunowedzera kugadzira. Asi ongororo yakabvunza chete kugutsikana kwakazviyerwa uye haina kuyera mushando chaiwo. Uyewo, vanopinda mukushanda uri kumba vakanyanya kuunganidzwa mumabasa ane kuzvitonga kwakawanda, saka zvakaoma kuona kana musiyano wekugutsikana unobva panzira yekushanda kana unhu hwemabasa. Naizvozvo mhedzisiro idzi bedzi hadzina kukwana kusvika pamhedziso yekuti kushanda uri kumba kunowedzera kugadzira.
texts.g:9d18f689: Chikamu chemari yekugara pamari yekupinza pamhuri dzose chinova nepakati pe22 muzana, mwero mumwe chete segore mashanu apfuura. Vamwe vanozvitora sehwaro hwekutaura kuti mutoro wemba haina kuchinja. Asi, chikamu chemhuri dzine mari yakaderera 20 muzana chakakwira kubva ku31 kusvika ku38 muzana, nepo chemhuri dzepamusoro 20 muzana chakadzika kubva ku15 kusvika ku12 muzana. Kukwira kune rimwe divi nekudzika kune rimwe zvakadzimiranana, uye pakati kwakangogara kwakafanana. Pakati inotiudza pakati pewose asi hairatidzi shanduko dzakaitika pakati pemapoka. Naizvozvo hatifaniri kusvetuka kubva pachokwadi chekuti pakati pakafanana kuenda kumhedziso yekuti mutoro wemhuri dzose wakafanana.
texts.g:36c84153: Mugore rayo rekutanga, Raibhurari yeHansol yakangovhurwa yakanga ine vashanyi vakawanda ne40 muzana kupfuura gore rakapfuura, uye guta rakatonga kuti tsika yekuverenga kwevagari yakapararira. Asi munguva imwe chete, mabhuku akakweretwa akawedzera ne3 muzana chete. Muongororo yevashandisi, vazhinji vakati vakauya kuzodzidzira muhoro yekuverenga. Huwandu hwevashanyi hunogona kuva chiratidzo chinoratidza kuwanikwa nekunyaradza kwechivakwa, asi hahuratidzi zvakananga huwandu hwekuverenga. Kutaura nezvekupararira kwetsika yekuverenga, zvimwe zviratidzo zvakadai sehuwandu hwemabhuku akakweretwa kana nguva yekuverenga zvinofanira kuratidzwa pamwe chete.
texts.g:877e9eb2: Kukwira kwemitengo yevatengi gore rino kwaiva 2.1 muzana zviri pamutemo, asi vagari vazhinji vanonzwa kuti mitengo yekurarama yakakwira zvakanyanya kupfuura izvozvo. Pamusiyano uyu, kutsoropodza kunomuka kuti manhamba anokanganisa chokwadi. Zvisinei, chiratidzo chemitengo ihuwandu hwunoverengwa nekuisa huremu hwezvinhu maererano nehurongwa hwekushandisa kwemhuri yepakati. Mugore apo mitengo yezvikafu inokwira ne5 muzana, mwero unonzwiwa nemhuri dzine mari shoma dzinoshandisa zvakawanda pazvikafu unofanira kuva wakakwira kupfuura wepakati. Pakupedzisira, musiyano uri pakati penhamba yepamutemo nezvinonzwiwa nevanhu hauumbwi nekuti kuverenga kwakaipa asi nekuti nhamba imwe haigoni kumiririra mhuri dzose.
texts.g:70fd5ba4: Kutengeswa kwechinwiwa chitsva kwakakwira ne20 muzana mumwedzi mitatu mushure mekutanga kushambadza muna Chikumi kana tichienzanisa nemwedzi mitatu yapfuura. Chikwata chekushambadza chakaratidza graph iyi sehumbowo hwemugumisiro wekushambadza. Zvisinei, chinwiwa ichi chigadzirwa chinowedzera kudiwa muzhizha, uye kunyange gore rakapfuura, pasina kushambadza, kutengesa kwakakwira ne18 muzana munguva imwe chete. Tichitarisa izvi, kukwira kunokonzerwa nekushambadza hakupfuure makore anenge maviri muzana. Zvakadaro, mamiriro ekunze nezvigadzirwa zvevakakwikwidza zvinogona kunge zvakasiyana pakati pegore rakapfuura nerino, saka kunyange nhamba iyi inonetsa kuitorwa semugumisiro wakasimbiswa.
texts.g:6a73ec88: Kana shopu yepaintaneti yakaita ongororo yekugutsikana kwevatengi, 35 muzana yevakapindura vakasarudza 'handigutsikani zvachose.' Vamwe vatungamiriri vakafunga kuti dambudziko rakakura rakamuka muhurongwa hwebasa. Asi chiyero chekupindura kweongororo chakanga chiri 12 muzana chete, uye vatengi vane zvichemo vanowanzopindura ongororo nesimba kupfuura vamwe. Saka nhamba ye35 muzana haigoni kuverengwa sekuongororwa kwevatengi vose. Izvi hazvirevi kuti data iyi haina basa. Zvikonzero zvekusagutsikana zvakanyorwa nevakapindura zvinogona kuva zviratidzo zvinoratidza kuti nzvimbo dzipi dzinofanira kuvandudzwa kutanga.
texts.g:70ffd4cd: Chiyero chepakati chevadzidzi vanosiya chisvusvuro chakanga chiri mapoinzi 6 pasi pechevadzidzi vanochidya. Mugumisiro uyu unowanzoshandiswa sechikonzero chekutaura kuti kudya chisvusvuro kunowedzera mugumisiro wekudzidza. Asi kana vadzidzi vemhuri dzine mari yakafanana chete vakaenzaniswa, kusiyana kwemapoinzi kwakaderera kusvika pa1.5. Izvi nekuti vadzidzi vemhuri dzine mari shoma vanowanzosiya chisvusvuro uye kazhinji vanewo nharaunda yekudzidza isingakanaki. Kuongorora uku hakureve kuti chisvusvuro hachina mhedzisiro chose, asi kunoratidza pachena kuti chikamu chikuru chekusiyana kwakatanga kuonekwa chinotsanangurwa nezvimwe zvikonzero.
texts.g:844ee22d: Kana sampuli yakaderera, kukanganisa kwemigumisiro kunowanzo kuva kukuru.
texts.g:d839f44d: Vanenge hafu yevakapindura vakati vanokoshesa mhando kupfuura mutengo.
texts.g:6fee16d1: Kunyange mari yekupinda yakakwira, mwero wekuchengeta mari wakazoratidza kuderera.
texts.n:k.k9.review_k9:revHon: Kudzokorora: -(으)시- inokudza mumwe munhu, zviito zvekuzvininipisa zve-드리- zvinotsanangura zviito zvako kwaari, uye -(스)ㅂ니다 inochengeta maitiro ari pamutemo.
texts.n:k.k9.review_k9:revVocab: Kudzokorora: mazita ebhizinesi eSino-Korea anowanzo kuoneka akafanana, saka sarudzai nezvinoreva uye nechiito chavanobatana naro.
texts.s:a122a17d: Mumwe anokumbira nguva yemusangano uye unofanira kutarisa kareka yako.
texts.s:0a04257f: Hauna kunzwisisa tsananguro uye unokumbira zvine rukudzo kuti dzokororwe.
texts.s:518a3c4f: Mushandi akabatana newe akakubatsira kupedzisa basa rako.
texts.s:041dba0a: Unovimbisa mutengi kuti uchaendesa gwaro pakupera kwezuva.
texts.s:c90c163d: Unobvumira muenzi zvine rukudzo kutanga kutaura mumusangano.
texts.g:3f33725f: Gwaro rerwendo rwebasa rinofanira kuendeswa mukati mevhiki mushure mekudzoka.
texts.g:eb27f927: Ndichaenderera mberi nenyaya iyi mushure mekuwana chibvumirano chemaneja wedhipatimendi.
texts.g:d5e564ff: Ndine basa rakawanda vhiki rino, saka ndinofunga ndichafanira kushanda nguva yekuwedzera.
texts.g:263851c9: Munogona kundiwana neMessenger kunyange ndichishanda ndiri kumba.
texts.g:81c8a6b9: Pane chinhu chinokurumidza chauya, saka handifungi kuti ndichakwanisa kupinda musangano.
texts.g:7a1064f6: Mutengesero wekota ino wakapfuura chinangwa nezvikamu gumi muzana.
texts.g:270a0a19: Ndapota tarisai mamiriro zvakare musati masaina kontrakiti.
texts.g:93802476: Chigadzirwa chitsva chakagamuchirwa zvakanaka, saka maodha akawedzera kaviri.
texts.g:c167797b:
A: Mutevedzeri wemaneja, mungaongorore here chirongwa cherwendo rwebasa rwemangwana?
B: Hongu, muchaenda kuBusan nendege yenguva yechipfumbamwe mangwanani.
A: Musangano wemutengi uri nguva yakadini?

texts.g:6a8b5faa:
Kuna Maneja weDhipatimendi Lee,
Ndiri kukumbira chibvumirano chenyu.
Ndabatanidza kontrakiti nemutengi mutsva, saka ndapota muitarise.
Ndingafara kana mungapindura mukati mezuva ranhasi.
texts.n:k.k10.culture_deep:habitual: Tsika dzinotaurwa nezviito zvenguva yazvino zvezvinoitwa nevanhu nguva dzose, kazhinji nemazita etsika kana tsika dzakare.
texts.g:c0eaaee5: Munhu ane nunchi inokurumidza anonzwa manzwiro emumwe munhu kunyange asina kuudzwa.
texts.g:99095a49: VaKorea vanokoshesa zvikuru kuchengetedza chiremera chavo pamberi pevamwe.
texts.g:fa697d7b: Pazuva reGore Idzva reMwedzi, vanhu vanotembera vakuru vavo vochipiwa mari yechipo.
texts.g:29a6105a: Vanhu vanoti unowana gore rimwe pazera nekudya soup yechikafu chechinyoro mangwanani eGore Idzva.
texts.g:54990d5f: PaChuseok, vanhu vanoshanyira makuva emadzitateguru avo.
texts.g:e756c6e1: Kune tsika yekudya soup yemhando yegungwa mangwanani ezuva rekuzvarwa.
texts.g:eaacf306: Pazuva rekutanga rekuzvarwa kwemwana, pamuitirwa bato uye mwana anosarudza chinhu patafura.
texts.g:bf6ebf5d: Chando chisati chasvika, vavakidzani vanounganidzana vochigadzirira kimchi pamwe chete.
texts.g:73b15dba: Kana uchienda kumwenga, itsika yakanaka kupa mari yechipo yekukorokotesa.
texts.g:c87cda76: Kana vachipinda mukuviswa, vanhu vanopa mari yekunyaradza uye vanochema vakanyarara.
texts.g:fb00f0a7: Mushure mekupinda mumba mutsva, vanhu vanokoka shamwari kubato rekupinda mumba mitsva.
texts.g:79b030c5: Kana uchinwa nemukuru, itsika yakanaka kutendeuka musoro wako uchinwa.
texts.g:587ded32: Kana uchipa mukuru chimwe chinhu, unoshandisa maoko ose maviri.
texts.g:16c17ab1: Kubvunza zera remunhu asinganzikamwi inzira yekusarudza mazita nemaitiro ekutaura.
texts.g:2b01b8d4: MuchiKorea, vanhu vanowanzotaura kuti 'wedu' kunyange pazvinhu zvakaita se'imba yangu' kana 'amai vangu'.
texts.g:b2e9b57e: Ondol hurongwa hwekupisa hwechinyakare hunodziya pasi.
texts.g:9f8f16af: Hanbok inopfekwa pamazuva akakosha senge mazuva ekupemberera nemichato.
texts.g:65461830: Vanhu vaitenda kuti kudya poriji yemabhinzi matsvuku pazuva rechando chikuru kunodzivirira rombo rakaipa.
texts.g:abde95a2: Mumazuva anopisa kwazvo ezhizha, vanhu vanodya soup yehuku neginseng kuti vadzorere simba.
texts.g:d7b6477c: Pamwedzi wakazara wekutanga wegore, vanhu vanoputsa nzungu uye vanodavira gore rine hutano.
texts.g:d002b1c5: Pazuva rebvunzo yekupinda kuyunivhesiti, nguva dzekutanga basa dzinononotswa uye munhu wese anokurudzira vanonyora bvunzo.
texts.g:74455bff: MuKorea, inokosha kuremekedza vabereki, mhuri dzakawanda dzaigara nevabereki vadzo uye kuvarera.
texts.g:7b9ccd1a: Pumasi tsika yekubatsirana nebasa nekudzorera zvakanaka.
texts.g:bfb397ed: Pamazuva makuru ekupemberera, mhuri dzinounganidzwa uye dzinoita mhemberero dzekurangarira madzitateguru.
texts.g:0476afea: PaZuva reHangul, vanhu vanorangarira kugadzirwa kwemavara echiKorea naMambo Sejong.
texts.g:20538219: Pajjimjilbang, vanhu vanozvuta ziya uye vanopedza nguva nemhuri neshamwari.
texts.g:fa5bf7ca: Pakudya, unotanga kudya mushure mekunge mukuru wepasi pose atora chipunu nemachopsticks ake.
texts.g:9512d04e: MuKorea, tsika ye'jeong' yekugoverana chikafu nevavakidzani yakaenderera kwenguva refu.
texts.g:09d4434e: Pane ongororo inoti tsika yeKorea ye'ppalli-ppalli' yakamera munguva yekukura kwehupfumi nekukurumidza.
texts.g:4a7216bf: Kushandisa mutauro unokudza nemutauro wakajairika zvakasiyana chizvarwa chemutauro chinoratidza hukama hwako nemumwe munhu.
texts.g:dbdd19d8: MuKorea, vanhu vanowanzodaidzwa nezita rebasa kana nehukama sa'amai va...' pane kudaidzwa nezita.
texts.g:203bdce4: Kuramba chikafu chinopiwa kamwe kana kaviri dzimwe nguva kunogona kubva pakuda kuva nemutsa.
texts.g:74724f36: Tsika yemazuva makuru eKorea iri kuchinja zvishoma nezvishoma. Kare, mhuri nehama dzaiungana mumba imwe dzichipedza mazuva dzichigadzira chikafu nekuita mhemberero dzemadzitateguru. Asi mazuva ano, mhuri dzakawanda dzinogadzirira matafura akareruka kana kuenda parwendo. Kunyange chimiro chichichinja, zvinoreva kupedza nguva pamwe chete nekuongororana zvichiri kutorwa sezvakakosha.
texts.g:4e23238d: Nhaka yetsika isingabatike inoreva ruzivo nehunyanzvi hwakapfuudzirwa nenhengo dzenzanga kuburikidza nezvizvarwa.
texts.g:fe5e1e70: Kunyange chimiro chayo chichichinja nenguva, mutambo wechinyakare unochengeta basa rawo rekusimbisa hukama hwenzanga.
texts.g:fae4710a: Nziyo dzechinyakare dzakapfuudzirwa mudunhu rega rega dzinoratidza hupenyu nemanzwiro evagari vacho.
texts.g:0942f6e7: Kuderedza kusanzwisisana pakati petsika, tinoda maitiro ekusatonga tsika imwe nemitemo yedu pachedu.
texts.g:7486b8d2: Kuremekedza kuzivikanwa kwetsika dzevanofambira kune dzimwe nyika kuri kukurukurwa sechinodiwa chekutanga pakubatanidzwa kwenzanga.
texts.g:afc76388: Nhasi tichatarisa kuchengetedzwa kwehanok kubva pakuona kwehurongwa hwenhaka yetsika. Hanok haisi nzvimbo yekugara chete asi chigadzirwa chetsika chakaunganidza mamiriro ekunze nenzira yekurarama. Zvisinei, kana ichigadziridzwa kuitira kunyaradza kwemazuva ano, chimiro chayo chakasiyana chinogona kukuvara. Pakuona uku, kuenzana pakati pekuchengetedza nekushandisa ndiyo nyaya huru.
texts.g:5eec1ae4: A: Pane kutsoropodza kuti mitambo yenzvimbo iri kuva yekutengesa zvakanyanya. B: Nekuti huwandu hwevashanyi hunoshandiswa sechiratidzo chebasa, nyaya dzenzvimbo dzakasiyana dzakadzikira mune zvimwe zvinhu. C: Ndinoona zvakasiyana. Vagari vanogona kuenderera nemutambo chete kana paine mari inopinda, saka zvakaoma kupikisa kutengesa pachako. Chinokosha kuvaka hurongwa hwekuti mari idzokere kunzanga yemuno.
texts.g:83f2d8a3: Hwaro hunozivisa migumisiro yekusarudzwa kwehurongwa hwayo hwerubatsiro hwekuchengetedza hunyanzvi hwechinyakare sezvinotevera. Gore rino mapoka manomwe pamakumi matatu akapa zvikumbiro akasarudzwa, uye kuongorora kwakatarisa kugona kupfuudzira hunyanzvi nehukama nenzanga yemuno. Mapoka asina kusarudzwa achapiwa mashoko ekuongorora nekunyorwa.
texts.g:acba7a7b: A: Kune kunetseka kukuru kuti mitauro yedunhu iri kunyangarika. Munofunga chikonzero chii? B: Nekuti mutauro wakajairika wakapararira zvakanyanya kuburikidza nenhepfenyuro nedzidzo, uye nekuti vechidiki vachienda kumaguta kwakaderedza mikana yekushandisa mutauro wedunhu. A: Chii chinofanira kuitwa kuchengetedza mitauro yedunhu? B: Pane kumira pakuinyora, inofanira kubatanidzwa nedzidzo yenzvimbo kuitira kuti ishandiswe chaizvo muhupenyu hwezuva nezuva.
texts.g:001b4b52: Musoro wemudzidziso wanhasi ndewekuti mamiriro etsika anofanira kubatwa sei mukushandura. Kushandura izwi neizwi kune mukana wekutendeka kune rakatangira, asi kunogona kusiya zvinoreva zvinonzwika zvisingajairiki kuvaverengi. Pane rimwe divi, kushandura kwakasununguka kuri nyore kuverenga, asi pane njodzi yekuti hunhu hwekutanga huparadzwe. Tichaenzanisa simba nehurema hwenzira mbiri idzi nemienzaniso.
texts.g:fedf0417: A: Pane kukakavara kwakawanda pamusoro petsika yekubvunza zera kutanga kana vanhu vachisangana. Munoiona sei? B: Sezvo chiKorea chichichinja mafomu ekudaidza nemaitiro ekutaura zvichienderana nemumwe munhu, ndinoona kubvunza zera senzira inoshanda yekuisa chimiro chenhaurirano. C: Ndinogamuchira basa iri, asi hazvipedzi here nehurongwa apo divi rakuru rinotungamira nhaurirano richisimba? B: Handiramba kuti mhedzisiro yakadaro iripo. Asi iyo mhedzisiro yakaunzwa netsika, kwete chikonzero chakaita kuti tsika iite. Kana hurongwa hwekudaidza hukachinja, mubvunzo uchaderera pachawo.
texts.g:fcb8250f: A: Tingatsanangura sei tsika yekuchinjana zvipo zveminyaya uye kuona kuti zvadzorerwa? B: Ndinoiona sechiratidzo chekuvimbana kwenguva refu. Chishuvo chekudzorera zvakagamuchirwa chinova tambo inochengeta hukama huchienderera. C: Asi kana vanhu vachiyedza kudzorera chaizvo chavakagamuchira, hazvisi izvo here zvisiri musiyano nekutengeserana? B: Pachiso zvinogona kuita saizvozvo. Asi dai yaiva kutengeserana, hukama hwaizopera panguva iyo mutengo unobhadharwa. Kuwedzera zvishoma pachipo chekudzorera kuti chikwereti chisara zvinoreva kuti munhu haarongi kupedza hukama. Handiramba kuti kuverenga kuripo. Zvinongova chinangwa chekuverenga uku kuenderera, kwete kuvhara maakaundi.
texts.g:46ef3493: A: Vamwe vanotsoropodza hanbok yezuva nezuva, yakagadziridzwa kuti ipfekwe muhupenyu hwezuva nezuva, kuti inokuvadza tsika. C: Ndinofunga kuti kana chimiro, senge huwandu hwejekete nesikati nekushandiswa kwemarebhoni ekusunga, chisingachengetwi, zvakaoma kuidaidza hanbok. B: Ndinobvuma kuti chimiro chekutanga chinofanira kukudzwa. Asi kana tikaomerera chimiro chekare kunyange pachinhu, kureba nenzira yekusunga, zvinogona kusara pasina anopfeka. C: Munoreva kuti kana pasina anopfeka, tsika inotemwa. B: Hongu. Nguvo yakaiswa mumuseum nenguvo inopfekwa nevanhu dzinochengetwa nenzira dzakasiyana. Ndinofunga yekupedzisira inogara kwenguva refu.
texts.g:8a212118: A: Mhuri dzinogara nevabereki dzakadzikira; kuziva kuremekedza vabereki kwakaderera here? B: Ndinofunga kuti hakuna kuderera zvakanyanya asi kwakachinja chimiro chekuratidza. Kunyange vanhu vasingagari pamwe chete, kuremekedza vabereki kunoenderera nekugovana mabhiri echipatara nekuramba vachitaurirana kazhinji. C: Kududzira uku kunotanga nepfungwa yekuti mhuri inoramba iine basa rekutarisira. Pfungwa iyoyo pachayo hairi dambudziko here? B: Mubvunzo pachawo unokodzera. Asi kusvikira hurongwa hwapa rubatsiro rwakakwana, pfungwa iyoyo haigoni kubviswa nekukurumidza. Hurongwa hwakazvimiswa, ndipo patinogona kutaura nezvekuremekedza vabereki sesarudzo pane mutoro.
texts.g:7a77c58f: A: Huwandu hwemhuri dzinogadzira kimchi dzoga hwuri kudzikira. Tsika yekugadzira kimchi iri kunyangarika here? B: Zvakaoma kutonga nehuwandu hwemhuri dzinogadzira dzoga. Kunyange vanhu vachitenga, kana tsika yekugovana nevavakidzani nekubvunza nezvavo ichisara, tsika inoenderera. C: Asi kana maitiro ekuungana kushanda pamwe chete akanyangarika, kugovana uku hakungachengeteki here? B: Kunetseka uku kune hunhu. Ndosaka sangano redu riri kuisa simba mukunyora nekutsigira tsika yekuungana nekugovana, pane kuravira kwekimchi.
texts.g:bc4d2c30: A: Vanoti kunonotsa nguva dzekutanga basa uye kunyange kugadzirisa kusimuka nekudzika kwendege pazuva rebvunzo kunoita senge kwakaoma kuvanhu vekunze. B: Ndinozvinzwisisa sechivimbiso chenzanga chekuchengetedza kururamisira kwebvunzo. Ndiko kuedza kuita kuti munhu wose anyore bvunzo pasi pemamiriro akafanana. C: Kufunga uku hakuwedzeri here mutoro unonzwiwa nevanonyora bvunzo? B: Zvinogona. Asi kana tikabvisa kufunga uku, kusaenzana kwemamiriro kungamuka. Ndinofunga kuti kudzikisa mutoro kunofanira kutanga kwete nekugadzirisa hukuru hwekufunga asi nekugadzirisa hurongwa hune mukana mumwe chete wekunyora bvunzo.
texts.g:8889d001: A: Mune dzimwe nzvimbo, kwakagadzirwa hurongwa hunoita kuti vanhu vachinjane basa ravo, rinoverengwa nemaawa. Zvinogona kunzi iyi inguva yazvino yepumasi here? B: Ndinofunga inotora mweya wayo. Yakafanana mukuti kuedza kunodzorerwa nehukama pachinzvimbo chemari. C: Asi sezvo hurongwa huchikura, mutengo wekunyora nekutarisira maawa hauwedzeri uye kushanda zvakanaka kuderera here? B: Ndiro pfungwa yakarurama. Saka ndinofunga hurongwa hwakadaro hunoshanda zvakanakisa muumbozha diki umo vanhu vanozivana, uye kuhwedzera kudhorobha rose hakuna kururama. Zvisinei, ndinoda kuwedzera kuti kukosha kwehurongwa uhu kuri muhukama, kwete mukushanda zvakanaka.
texts.n:k.k10.idioms_action:figurativeB: Tsumo dzinodzidzwa semayuniti akazara muchimiro chazvo chenguva dzose chemuduramazwi; zvinoreva zvemufananidzo hazvigoni kufungidzirwa kubva kumazwi chaiwo.
texts.n:k.k10.idioms_action:noun: Dzimwe tsumo mhoteredzo dzemazita kana dzezvipauro pachinzvimbo chezviito, uye dzinobatanidzwa pamutsara semumwe mutsanangudzi.
texts.n:k.k10.idioms_action:id: Tsumo yenhengo yemuviri iyuniti yakagadzikana inochinja sechiito chakajairika; zvinoreva zvemufananidzo zvinoratidzwa nemamiriro anotsanangurwa mumutsara wose.
texts.g:e4199708: kunyunyuta, kunyanya kumuroora kana mukadzi nezvemari
texts.g:606b4234: kupinda nemwoyo wose uchibatsira nesimba rose
texts.g:81a715a9: kuva nerupo pahuwandu, kupa kana kubika zvakawanda
texts.g:fae74777: kuva nezvinodiwa zvakakwirira uye kushaya kugutsa nyore
texts.g:8d4823f1: kurumbidza kana kudzokorora chinhu kakawanda kusinganeti
texts.g:beb2e810: Kuratidzira kuri mangwana uye handisati ndapedza kunyange hafu yezvinhu, saka ndakamanikidzwa chaizvo nenguva.
texts.g:65796e7b: Maodha ose auya panguva imwe pakupera kwegore, saka mazuva ano ndiri kuputira pasina nguva yekuzorora.
texts.g:95f9da6d: Shamwari yangu inoziva kuchengeta chakavanzika, saka haina kuudza munhu wose kunetseka kwandakaitaurira.
texts.g:a637ac09: Mukuru wechikamu ane hukama hukuru muindasitiri, saka pakambani yega yega ane munhu mumwe chete waanoziva.
texts.g:282997a3: Nekuva mutungamiriri wechikwata nyowani anobvunzwa nemigumisiro yevanhu gumi, zvakajairika kunzwa kurema kwemutoro.
texts.g:b28c79ea: Mwana akanga arasika paakadzoka mushure memaminitsi gumi, vabereki vakaisa mwoyo pasi.
texts.g:ec0632e9: Ndakabata dambudziko remasvomhu kwenguva yeawa yose, asi nekuti ndakanga ndisingagone kurigadzirisa chose, pakupedzisira ndakarisiya.
texts.g:b74d6f4a: Mhosva inonzwiwa kazhinji nevashandi mumisangano ndeyekuti pfungwa dzavo hadzitorwi kunyange vachitaura. texts.g:76873424: ChiKorea chine zvirevo zvakawanda zvinoshandisa zvikamu zvomuviri. Kududzira zvirevo zvakadaro izwi nezwi kunokonzera kusanzwisisa nyore. Saka zvirevo zvinofanira kudzidzwa pamwe chete nemamiriro ezvinhu zvinoshandiswa mazviri.
texts.n:k.k10.logic_debate:connector: Mazita akasungwa nezviperengo seye -(으)ㄴ 만큼 anotaura chikonzero kana mwero uye ndizvo zvinowanzoshandiswa mukufunga kwepamutemo mumareport.
texts.n:k.k10.logic_debate:concession: Zviratidzo zvekubvuma nezvemamiriro seye 'kunyangwe', 'kana', uye 'zvisinei nokuti zvakadini' zvinoda zviperengo zvinoenderana gare gare mumutsara.
texts.n:k.k10.logic_debate:nominalise: Mareport akanyorwa anoshandura zvikamu zvemitsara kuita zvirevo zvezita nezviperengo -ㅁ/-기 uye anobatanidza nazvo zvikamu zvechinhu, mubati kana muiti.
texts.n:k.k10.logic_debate:academicHedge: Kunyora kwepachikoro kunoderedza simba rezvirevo nenzira dzakagadzirwa seye 'zvinogona', 'pamwe', uye 'zvakaoma kusimbisa' pachinzvimbo chekutaura nechokwadi.
texts.n:k.k10.logic_debate:academicConn: Nharo dzakanyorwa dzepamutemo dzinoshandisa zvirevo zvakagadzika zvekubatanidza nekubvuma, zviperengo zvazvo zvichifanira kuenderana nemutsara wazvinobatanidza.
texts.n:k.k10.logic_debate:causeLink: Zvibatanidzi seye 이에 따라 ne 결과적으로 zvinosunga mhedzisiro kuchikonzero chichangotaurwa, saka mutsara wapamberi unofanira kupa chikonzero ichocho.
texts.n:k.k10.logic_debate:hedge: Zviperengo zvinoderedza seye -(으)ㄹ 것으로 보이다 ne -기 어렵다 zvinochengetedza chirevo chakanyorwa chepamutemo chisina chokwadi chakasimba pachinzvimbo chekuchitaura zvakananga.
texts.n:k.k10.logic_debate:nominal: Zvirevo zvezita zvakaitwa zita zvinopera ne -(으)ㄴ/는 + zita, -다는/-리라는 + zita, kana -에 대한 + zita zvinopfupisa mutsara wose kuti ushande semubati wemutsara wepamutemo.

texts.g:d0f04f2b: Kudza sarudzo dzevatengi, asi mutoro wemakambani unofanirawo kubvunzwa zvakajeka.
texts.g:f075b727: Vamwe vanhu vanoomerera kuti makirasi ose echikoro anofanira kuendeswa paintaneti. Zvechokwadi, makirasi epaintaneti ane mukana wekudzikisa miganhu yenguva nenzvimbo. texts.g:1788bcc5: Sezvo vashanduri veAI vachishandiswa zvakanyanya, pfungwa yekuti kudzidza mitauro yekune dzimwe nyika hakuchadiwi iri kukura. Asi vashanduri vanowanzoshaya chinangwa chakanyanya chinotakurwa nemamiriro kana manzwiro enzwi. Kuti uone kana shanduro yakarurama, mushandisi anofanira kunzwisisa mutauro uyo pakupedzisira. Muchidimbu, mushanduri chishandiso chinobatsira kudzidza mutauro wekune dzimwe nyika, kwete chinochitsiva.
texts.g:a246688e: Zvinowanzonzi makwikwi ndiwo simba rekufambira mberi. Chokwadi makwikwi anowedzera kuedza. Asi kana makwikwi akanyanya, vanhu vanovanzirana ruzivo kunyange pane kudiwa kubatana, uye mushando wose unodzika. Kana zvakadaro, dambudziko hariripo pakuvapo kwemakwikwi asi mwero nemufananidzo wawo. Pakupedzisira, zvatinofanira kubvunza hazvisi kuti tibvise makwikwi here asi kuti tiumbe makwikwi emhando ipi.
texts.g:99463034: A: Ndinotsigira kuwedzera kushanda uri kumba. Zvinopfupisa nguva yekufamba, izvo zvinokwidziridza hupenyu hwevashandi. B: Ndinobvuma chakanakira chamunotaura. Asi ongororo iri humbowo hwenyu yakangobata vashandi vemahofisi chete. Zvakaoma kutaura kuti mhedziso imwecheteyo inoshanda kunyange kumapoka emabasa anoda kuvapo pachinzvimbo. A: Zvakanaka. Ndosaka ndichikurudzira kuti tigovanise mwero wekuiswa nemapoka emabasa.
texts.g:4a61030a: Vamwe vanhu vanonetsekana kuti dzidziso yeChirungu yekutanga inodzivirira kukura kwemutauro wamai. Asi kunetseka uku kunotsamira pachirevo chekuti mukana wemwana wekusangana nemutauro wamai unoderedzwa nemutauro wekune dzimwe nyika. Chaizvoizvo, ongororo dzakawanda dzinoratidza kuti kuvana vanoshandisa mutauro wamai zvakakwana kumba, kusangana nemutauro wekune dzimwe nyika hakukuvadze kugona mutauro wavo wekuzvarwa. Chinokosha hazvisi kuti mutauro wekune dzimwe nyika unodzidzwa nekukurumidza here asi kuti mamiriro emutauro wamai anochengetwa zvakanaka sei. Kana chirevo chachinja, mhedziso inofanira kuchinjawo.
texts.g:6001b679: Mushumo uyu unoongorora kuti hurongwa hwebhajeti rekubatanidza vagari hwakawedzera kujeka kwemari. Asi humbowo hwakapiwa hwakangova ongororo yekugutsikana yevagari vakapinda. Kugutsikana kwakakwirira hakuzoreva kuti mari yakajeka. Dai zviratidzo zvisingatsvakirwi pfungwa dzakadai sehuwandu hwekuburitswa kwekuitwa kwebhajeti kana nhamba yezvakawanikwa muongororo dzakaiswawo, kuvimba nemhedziso kwaizova kwakakwirira zvikuru. Pakupedzisira, mhedziso yemushumo yakatora nhanho dzakanyanya kupfuura humbowo hwayo.
texts.g:5083f824: Vamwe vanoti kurambidza mapipi epurasitiki hakungaite musiyano mukuru nokuti mapipi chikamu chidiki chemarara ose epurasitiki. Kana tichitarisa nhamba oga, izvozvo hazvisi zvisiri izvo. Asi kuti chinangwa chemutemo wemapipi chingotarisa huwandu hwemarara akaderedzwa, kududzira kwakamanikana. Izvi zvinodaro nokuti mutemo uyu ndiwo mutangiro unomiririra unobvunza tsika dzekushandisa dzaitora zvinhu zvekurasa sezvakajairika. Naizvozvo, pakutonga mhedzisiro yawo, tinofanira kuyera shanduko dzekuziva pamwe chete nehuwandu.
texts.g:f657e674: Pamusangano sachigaro akati nyaya iyi inofanira kuongororwa. Asi pakarepo akawedzera kuti sezvo budiriro yemari yakanga yapera, sarudzo mukati megore rino yaizove yakaoma. Nhengo dzekomiti dzaivapo dzakatora izvi sechiratidzo chekuti kuitumira gore rino kwakanga kwakaoma chaizvo. Kunyange zvazvo kuongororwa kwakanaka kwakatanga, mamiriro akabatanidzwa pashure akaratidza nzira chaiyo. Imwe nhengo yakati mashoko aya akapfava asi zvaireva zvakajeka.
texts.g:9b42270e: Kunetseka kuti tekinoroji inobvisa mabasa hakusi kutsva. Kushushikana kwakafanana kwakavapo painoshanda hwindi remagetsi pakabuda. Asi kana tichitarisa nhoroondo, tekinoroji yakabvisa mamwe mabasa asi yakasvikawo kusikawo mabasa akanga asipo kare. Kuva nechivimbo pachikonzero ichi kuchakurumidza. Shanduko dzakapfuura dzakaitika kwemakumi emakore, asi shanduko yazvino inokurumidza kwazvo. Kana pasina nguva yakakwana yekuzvisimudzira, kungobuda kwemabasa matsva hakugoni kuderedza kushushikana kwemunhu mumwe nemumwe.
texts.g:a28eef03: Nyanzvi dzinowanzoenzanisa kuvhiringika kwemotokari mumaguta nemamiriro eshinda dzropa dzakavharika. Kudzokorora kuvhiyiwa kunobvumbura shinda dzakavharika hakuvandudzi hutano kubva pamudzi. Sezvinoita kuti tsika dzehupenyu dzifanire kushanduka, mutemo unoshandisa bhajeti pakuwedzera migwagwa chete unoderedza kuvhiringika kwenguva pfupi, uye pasina nguva mota dzinowedzera zvakare. Zvinoreva fananidzo iyi ndezvekuti pakada nzira inoshandura mutakure wveruzhinji nehurongwa hweguta pamwe chete.
