texts.g:ef9867a4: Chakanakira chikuru chekushanda uri kumba ndechekuti chinoderedza nguva yekufamba, nokuti nguva yaishandiswa pakufamba inogona kushandiswa pakuzorora nokuzvichengetedza. Asi, zvakaoma kuramba kuti kubatana pakati penhengo kunova kwakaoma. Naizvozvo, panzvimbo pokushandisa nzira imwe chete pamabasa ose, zvakanaka kubatanidza nokuchinjika kushanda muhofisi nokushanda uri kumba maererano nemhando yebasa.
texts.g:ed4061c8: Mune imwe ongororo, vadzidzi vanosiya kudya chisvusvuro vakaratidza mamakisi akaderera pamwero. Pachinhu ichi, pakamutswa nharo yekuti chisvusvuro chive chinodikanwa. Asi vazhinji vevadzidzi vanosiya kudya chisvusvuro vakanga vasina kurara zvakakwana nokuti vaienda kumakirasi ekuwedzera kusvikira husiku hwakadzika. Kuti zvizivikanwe kuti chinhu chipi chinokanganisa mamakisi, kuenzanisa nenguva yokurara iri pamamiriro akafanana kunodiwa. Ongororo yakaitwa pavadzidzi mazana maviri vemuzvikoro zvitatu zvesekondari.
texts.g:340f7372: Guta rinofunga kuvhara dziva rokushambira reguta. Mutengo wekushanda pamushandisi mumwe wakaitwa kaviri pamutengo wenzvimbo yakavanzika iri padyo wakaiswa sehwaro hukuru. Asi nhamba iyi inosanganisira kushandisa pasina muripo kwevakuru nevana, uye mari yekurapwa yakaderedzwa nokuvandudzwa kwehutano hwevashandisi haina kuverengwa. Kuti ndiani akaisa hwaro hwokuenzanisa, uye nenzira ipi, hazvina kuziviswa. Guta rinoronga kuisa mutemo wokupedzisira nokukurumidza mwedzi unouya. Boka revashandisi rakatanga kuunganidza zvisaina zvinopikisa kuvhara.
texts.g:798f379b: Nharo yekuti kurapwa kuri kure kunofanira kubvumirwa zvizere inowana simba rinoshamisa munzvimbo dzine nzvimbo dzekurapa dzishoma. Asi, nharo inopikisa yekuti, kuvarwere vanoenda kekutanga, mukana wekurapa zvisiri izvo wakaoma kubvisa pasina kuongororwa pachena hazvigoni kutorwa zviri nyore. Pakupedzisira, nyaya iri pakurwisana inoita seiri pachinhu chiri pakati pekubvumira nekurambidza kupfuura pakuti ndezvipi zvekurapa zvinofanira kubvumirwa pasi pemamiriro api. Nyaya iyi yakarongerwa kubatwa senyaya huru pamusangano wekuvandudza hurongwa hwekurapa unoitirwa mukati megore rino.
texts.g:ef70cb2f: Tsumo inoenzanisa nhoroondo negirazi inowanzoitika. Asi girazi rinongo ratidza zviri pamberi paro, uye harizvisarudzi nokuzvo kuti ritarise kupi uye rivhare kupi. Muhurongwa hwekuronga nhoroondo, sarudzo yezvinofanira kunyorwa nezvinofanira kusiiwa inoitwa kutanga. Chiitiko chimwe chete chinosara chiri chiitiko chakasiyana zvachose zvichienderana nokuti ndiani anochinyora nenguva ipi. Izvi zvinodaro nokuti kusarudza nekurongwa kwezvinobva pachiri pachacho ndiko kutangira kududzira. Zvinowora mufananidzo wegirazi ibhii remunhu ari kuratidza.
texts.g:245fcc4b: Pane tsvakurudzo dzakawanda dzinoratidza kuti kuomesa miganhu yekumhanya kunoderedza kufa kwemumigwagwa. Asi, dzakawanda dzetsvakurudzo idzi dzakanangana nezvikamu zvaiva nemakamera ekuyeuchidza. Kana mhedzisiro imwecheteyo ichaonekwa munzvimbo dzisina kuitirwa kuomerera hazvisati zvatsvakirwa. Kunetseka kwekuti mutemo unongochinja nhamba yemuganhu wekumhanya unogona kutadza kuunza mhedzisiro yakatarisirwa kunobva pano. Mubvunzo uyu wakamutswa kakawanda munzvimbo dzine mamiriro emigwagwa akasiyana. Kukurukurirana nezvebhirozvino rinoenderana kwakamira parizvino.
texts.g:2b820a90: A: Pane mushumo unoti nguva yekurara yepakati yakawedzera mushure mekuiswa munyika yakadzivirira zviri pamutemo vechidiki kupinda mumitambo husiku. B: Mushumo uyu wakatevera gore rimwe chete mushure mekurambidza, wakangori wevadzidzi veguta rimwe chete, uye kune ongororo yakaparadzana inoratidza kuti kupfuura mutemo kwakawedzera. A: Kuvapo kwekupfuura mutemo hakuiti kuti kurambidza kusava nechinangwa. Kunyange vamwe vachipfuura, nguva yekubatana pachayo yakaderera. B: Handisi kuti hazvina chinangwa; ndiri kuti tinofanira kungwarira zvakanyanya pakutaura hukuru hwemhedzisiro.
texts.g:b25acd75: Kambani inoshambadza kuti mubayiro wepakati wevashandi vayo uri pakati pemabayiro akakwirira muindasitiri. Asi mubayiro wepakati uyu unosanganisira mubayiro wevatariri vatatu. Kambani inoronga kuderedza hukuru hwekuhaya vatsva nehafu gore rino kuenzaniswa negore rakapfuura. Sangano revashandi rinoti kana vatariri vakabviswa uye pakati pakaverengwa, nhamba iyi inosvikira kunyange pasi pepakati peindasitiri. Asi kambani haina kuburitsa kuti yakaverenga sei mubayiro wepakati, uye kuverenga kwesangano zvakare hakuna kupiwa gwaro rinobva. Mutsara wekushambadza wakaiswawo pabhodhi remukati.
texts.g:ba65edb4: Zvakaoma kusvika pamhedziso yakasimba pamusoro pemhedzisiro yemutemo kubva pamhedzisiro iyi bedzi.
texts.g:89ee8852: Tisati tasarudza kuisa hurongwa, kuongororwa kwemhedzisiro dzakaipa dzinotarisirwa kunofanira kutanga.
texts.g:6170ca92: Kana kududzira uku kuri kwakarurama, zvinoita sekuti dzidziso iripo ichafanira kugadziriswa.
texts.g:1cacfd4d: Sezvo huwandu hwemuenzaniso husina kukwana, mhedzisiro iyi inofanira kugamuchirwa senguva pfupi.
texts.g:05b58da0: Chinotarisirwa chakamuka chekuti kana mutemo ukapfavisa, kupinda kwemakambani matsva kuchava kunoshanda.
texts.g:b2b9a6fb: Mushumo uri kutaurwa unogona kuoma kupukunyuka kutsoropodzwa kwekuti wakakudza zvakanyanya mhedzisiro yemutemo.
texts.g:c588c2f4: Chiitiko ichi chinodudzirwa semhedzisiro yezvikonzero zvakawanda zvichiita pamwe chete kwete chikonzero chimwe chete.
texts.g:5e706eae: Kana huwandu hwekukurukurirana hukawedzerwa, pane kunetseka kuti nyaya huru ingangova isingaonekwi zvakajeka.
texts.g:854277b6: Vamwe vatsvakurudzi vanoti kushandisa mubayiro wakaderera wakasiyana nenzvimbo kwaizodzoreredza mabasa kumaruwa. Vanoti, kana mari yevashandi ikadzika, nzvimbo dzebasa diki dzinowana simba rekuhaya vazhinji. Nharo iyi haisi isina hwaro zvachose. Asi kana musiyano wemabayiro ukawedzera, vechidiki vanogona kuenda vazhinji zvakare kuguta guru, uye vashandi venharaunda vanogona kuderera. Kana pasina vasara kushanda, mabasa akawedzerwa haazozadzwi. Naizvozvo, kushandiswa kwakasiyana kunokodzera kufungwa chete kana nzira dzekuwedzera dzekumisa kubuda kwevanhu dzagadzirirwa panguva imwecheteyo.
texts.g:b2bd772f: Mhaka dzinoramba dzichiitika dzinoti masangano ehurumende, kunyange mushure mekugamuchira chikumbiro chekuwana ruzivo, anovanza magwaro achitaura kuchengetedza ruzivo rwemunhu. Hapana anopikisa kuti kuchengetedza ruzivo rwemunhu inhanho yakakosha. Asi kuvanza magwaro ose kunyange ayo aigona kuburitswa kana ichingovharwa zvirevo zvinoziva zvakadai semazita kana kero kwakaenzana nekutiza mutoro kupfuura kuchengetedza. Kusaburitsa kunofanira kuva kusiyana, uye pakushandisa kusiyana, sangano rinofanira kuratidza kuti zvinodiwa. Pakupedzisira, nyaya haisi yekuburitsa kana kusaburitsa asi kuti ungavhara kusvika kupi.
texts.g:e39bdff0: Mushure mekunge sangano rekutsvagurudza rabudisa mhedzisiro yeongororo inoratidza kuti vadzidzi vanosiya kudya chisvusvuro vane mamakisi akaderera, chirevo chakapararira chekuti chisvusvuro chinokwidziridza mamakisi. Ongororo inosimbisa kuti zvinhu zviviri izvi zvinofamba pamwe chete. Asi kuti izvi zvitorwe sehumbowo hwechikonzero, kukanganisa kwezvimwe zvinhu zvakadai semamiriro emhuri kana nguva yekurara kunofanira kubviswa. Ongororo iyi haina kudzora zvinhu zvakadaro. Naizvozvo, zvinoratidzwa nemhedzisiro kungova hukama chete, uye hachisati chakwana sehwaro hwemazano emutemo anokurudzira chisvusvuro.
texts.g:fc68b080: Mutemo wekuti chimiro chekutanga chinofanira kuchengetwa chisina kuchinjwa pakudzorera nhaka yetsika wakagamuchirwa zvakanyanya. Kunetseka kwekuti kuzadza zvikamu zvakakuvara nezvinhu zvitsva kunovhiringidza chokwadi chenhoroondo kunewo chinhu. Asi, kana munhu achiomerera kuchengeta chekutanga chete uye achirega chivakwa chichiputsika, chinhu chiri kuchengetwa chinonyangarika. Chokwadi hachingobvi pakuchengeta zvinhu zvekare chete asi nekutaura pachena kuti zvikamu zvipi zvakadzorerwa. Naizvozvo, zvakanaka kudzorera zvinodiwa chete uye kunyora zvikamu zvakadzorerwa zvichisiyana.
texts.g:15ba669d: Hurumende yenharaunda yakapedza chirongwa chekuyedza rubatsiro rwemba uye yakazivisa kuti kugutsikana pakati pemhuri dzakabatsirwa kwakapfuura makumi mapfumbamwe muzana. Manzwiro ekuti rubatsiro rwakabatsira anewo zvaanoreva. Asi kugutsikana kunongoratidza kutenda kwakanzwiwa nevakabatsirwa uye hakuyeri zvakananga kana kugadzikana kwemba kwakavandudzwa chaizvo. Kuzivisa chirongwa kuti chakabudirira pasina zviratidzo zvinotsvakirwa pfungwa zvakadai sehuwandu hwekutama kana chikwereti chetsvarakadzi kwakakurumidza. Kuti kuwedzere kana kwete kunogona kusarudzwa mushure mekusimbisa zviratidzo izvi, uye hazvizononoka.
texts.g:25fd318d: Hurongwa hwekupera kwemitemo, hunopa mitemo nguva yekushanda, hunoongororwa sechishandiso chinodzivirira mitemo isingadiwi kuramba iripo. Kana mutemo ukanyangarika wega pazuva rakagadzwa, dhipatimendi rinotarisira haribvumi asi kufunga zvakare nezvekudiwa kwawo. Zvisinei, kana mitemo yehutano nekuchengetedzwa ikapera nenzira yemichina, mukaha unoitika uye kukuvara kunowira vagari. Kuti chinangwa chehurongwa hwekupera chizadziswe, kuoma kwekuongorora kuwedzera kunofanira kusiyana maererano nehunhu hwemutemo pachinzvimbo chekubata mitemo yose nechiyero chimwe chete.
texts.g:d78ca367: Pane pfungwa yekuti mugumisiro webhokisi-ofisi unovimbisa kukosha kwebasa. Chokwadi chekuti vanotarisa vazhinji vakachisarudza chiratidzo chisingaregererwi. Zvisinei, sezvo huwandu hwevanotarisa huchikanganwawo nehukuru hwekuzivisa nehuwandu hwemachira ekuratidzira, haungasi pakarepo chiyero chemhando yehunyanzvi. Pane izvi, kutarisa kuti vateereri vakapindura sei pasi pemamiriro akafanana uye kana kuyevedza kwemuromo kwakaramba kwenguva kunosvika padhuze nekuongororwa kwakanyanya kunyatsonaka. Saka, kubudirira kwebhokisi-ofisi ndiko chete kutanga kweongororo uye hakugoni kuva mhedziso.
texts.n:k.k10.media_article:plainStyle: Nhau nezvinyorwa zvevanyori vemapepanhau zvinonyorwa nemaitiro akajeka ekunyora pachinzvimbo chemaitiro ekutaura ane rukudzo, uye zvinoshandisa maitiro akagadzikana ekuzivisa.
texts.n:k.k10.media_article:reporting: Zviito zvekuzivisa zvakadai se'akazivisa', 'akaratidza', kana 'akaburitsa pachena' zvinobatanidzwa pachikamu chinotaurwa nechipetwa chekutora mashoko.
texts.n:k.k10.media_article:forecast: Vatori venhau vanotaura zvinotarisirwa nezvipetwa zvakagadzikana zvinoreva 'zvinotarisirwa', 'zvinoratidza kuti zvichaitika', kana 'zvinofungidzirwa'.
texts.n:k.k10.media_article:nominalise: Mishumo yakanyorwa inoshandura zvikamu kuita mhoteredzo dzemazita nezvipetwa -ㅁ/-기 uye inobatanidza zvikamu zvechinhu, chiitiko kana muiti kwazvo.
texts.n:k.k10.media_article:academicHedge: Kunyora kwezvedzidzo kunorerutsa zvirevo nemaitiro akagadzikana akadai se'zvingagona', 'zvinogona', uye 'zvakaoma kutaura' pachinzvimbo chekutaura chokwadi chakazara.
texts.n:k.k10.media_article:academicConn: Gakava rakanyorwa rinoshandisa zvinongedzo nemataurirwo ekubvuma akagadzikana ane zvipetwa zvinofanira kuenderana nechikamu chavanobatanidza.

texts.g:8c8e1913: Vamwe vanewo hanya kuti danho iri rinogona, zvinopesana, kuwedzera kuvhiringidzika kwemusika.
texts.g:b7a6d5ec: Mukuongororwa kwevashandi vemahofisi chiuru chimwe nesangano rekutsvagurudza, makumi matanhatu nesere muzana evakapindura vakange vaita basa uri kumba vakati kugutsikana kwavo nebasa kwakawedzera. Kune rimwe divi, makumi mana nemaviri muzana vakati kutaurirana pakati penhengo dzechikwata kwakaderera. Sangano rakaongorora kuti kuti zvakanakira kushanda uri kumba zvishandiswe zvakakwana, nzira dzekutaurirana dzakadai semisangano yevhidhiyo yenguva dzose dzinodiwa.
texts.g:309b4d03:
[Chiziviso] Kugadziriswa kwenzvimbo yeraibhurari yeguta
Raibhurari yeguta ichavhara nguva pfupi makamuri ekuverengera kwemavhiki maviri, kubva paKurume 4 kusvika paKurume 17, nekuda kwebasa rekugadzirisa nzvimbo. Munguva imwecheteyo, kukweretesa nekudzorera mabhuku kuchaenderera sezvakajairika pachitebhura chemashoko pamusoro wekutanga. Tinokumbira kuti mutinzwisise nekuda kwenhamo yenzwi rekuvaka.
texts.g:bfc7a9a5: Munguva pfupi yapfuura, zvikumbiro zvevagari zvekuti kuve nenzvimbo dzemadhogi oga mumapaki epakati peguta zvakawedzera. Hofisi yedunhu yakasarudza kuisa nzvimbo mbiri dzekuedza mukati megore rino uye kusarudza nezvekuwedzera mushure mekutarisa mhaka dzekutyora mitemo nehuwandu hwezvichemo. Asi, vamwe vagari vari kupikisa, vachitaura nezvenyaya dzenzwi nehutsanana.
texts.g:3e0d9d66: Munguva pfupi yapfuura, hurumende dzimwe dzomunharaunda dzave kukwikwidzana kuzivisa kuti dzichagadzira nzvimbo yemapaki eguta yakakura sei. Asi nzvimbo yepaki oga haireve hupenyu hwakanaka zvakanyanya kuvagari. Kunyange kana nzvimbo huru dzakasvibira dzikavakwa kumigumo yeguta kunosvikika zvakaoma, vagari vachazviwana zvakaoma kuzvishandisa mukuvapo kwezuva nezuva. Budiriro yemutemo inofanira kutongwa kwete nekuti nyika yakaitwa yakawanda sei asi nekuti vagari vakawanda sei vanoinakidzwa padyo nemba. Chero ichingova mujaho wenhamba, mutemo wenzvimbo dzakasvibira hauchabvi pakutsoropodzwa kwekuti kutonga kwekuratidza.
texts.g:a534b217: Chidzidzo ichi chakaongorora mhedzisiro yekuisa maawa ebasa anochinjika pamakambani madiki nepakati ane 320 munzvimbo yeguta guru. Kubuda kwevashandi kwakaderera nepakati pemapoinzi ekubata 3.1 pamakambani akagamuchira hurongwa uhu, asi kubatana nekukura kwekutengesa hakuna kukosha maererano nehuwandu. Asi, nekuti muenzaniso wakatsamira kumabhizinesi akati, pane miganhu yekuwedzera mhedzisiro kune vose. Naizvozvo, tsvakurudzo inotevera inofanira kuyedzazve mhedzisiro mumabhizinesi akasiyana nehukuru hwemakambani.
texts.g:e48636af: Hurumende yasarudza kuwedzera bhajeti rayo rekubata nekuderera kwekuberekwa nhanho nenhanho kubva gore rinouya. Asi, hurongwa uhu hunosiyana neakare nokuti hunosiya rubatsiro rwemari uye hunotarisa pakuvaka zvivakwa zvekuchengeta vana. Hurumende yakatonga kuti mari yekubereka yoga haigone kugadzirisa zvikonzero zvepasi zvinokanganisa sarudzo yekuva nemwana, ndiko kuti mutoro wekurera vana nekuoma kwekuenzanisa basa nemhuri. Naizvozvo ichaisa hafu yebhajeti kana kupfuura pakuwedzera zvikoro zvevacheche nenzvimbo dzekuchengeta vana mushure mechikoro.
texts.g:58d6ef44: Pfungwa yekuti mutauro hausi chinhu chekuchengeta pfungwa chete asi muumbi unoumba kufunga kwedu yavepo kwenguva refu. Iyi ndiyo inonzi linguistic relativity hypothesis. Tsvakiridzo dzazvino dzinonyanya kusatsigira pfungwa iyi zvikuru asi dzinoigamuchira nenzira yepakati: kuti mutauro unogona kukanganisa zvishoma kumhanya kwekuona mapoka akati kana kwakananga kutarisisa. Mune mamwe mazwi, dzinoona mutauro uchikanganisa mafambiro ekufunga pane kuzvitonga.
texts.g:de67f65c: Mushure mekunge chipatara chemuno chazivisa kuti chichabvisa kutarisira kwehusiku, honyanga dzevagari dzakaenderera. Chipatara chakataura kushomeka kwevashandi vezvehutano nekushaya mari. Asi kana kutarisira kwehusiku kukanyangarika, vokutanga kutambura vachava vakuru vasina rwendo runyaradza. Hatigoni kuramba zvizere kufunga kwekutarisira kwechipatara, asi hatigoni kusabvunza kuti zvinonzwisisika chaizvo here kutonga basa rakakosha reveruzhinji sehutano nemubhadharo chete. Ndosaka matanho erubatsiro kubva kuhurumende yedunhu anofanira kuenderana.
texts.g:6e1dc6da: Vatsvagiri vakatevera vadzidzi vechikoro chepuraimari 480 kwemakore maviri kuti vaongorore hukama pakati pehuwandu hwekuverenga nemazwi. Boka raiverenga zvakawanda rakaratidza mapoinzi akakwirira emazwi. Zvisinei, vatsvagiri havana kusvika pamhedziso yekuti kuverenga kwakakwidza mazwi. Izvi zvinokonzerwa nekuti havagoni kuramba mukana wekuti vana vaiva nemazwi akasimba kare vaifarira kuverenga zvakawanda kubva pakutanga. Kuti vasimbise hukama hwechikonzero nemugumisiro, vakawedzera kuti tsvakiridzo yemiedzo inochinja nemaune nharaunda yekuverenga inofanira kutevera.
texts.g:9de5619c: Komiti yedu inonzwira tsitsi chinangwa chekugadziridza uku. Zvisinei, tinotenda kuti maitiro ekungwarira anodiwa munzira yekuunza zuva rekutanga kushanda pamberi. Nzvimbo dzebasa diki dzinowana zvakaoma kuwana vashandi nemari kuti dzisangane nemitemo mitsva munguva pfupi, uye kana mitemo ikaomeswa pasina kugadzirira pane njodzi yekuti kuvharwa kuwedzere zvichipesana nechinangwa. Saka komiti inokurudzira kuisa nguva dzekutenda maererano nehukuru uye kupa rubatsiro rwehunyanzvi panguva iyoyo.
texts.g:45b728fe: Vashandi vakamhanyira mumaguta panguva yekutanga yeindasitiri vakazviwana vari mudzimba dzakaipa. Vanyori vezvepfungwa venguva iyoyo vakapindura dambudziko iri nenzira mbiri huru. Rimwe divi rakaratidza kusava nehungwaru hwemunhu pachake sechikonzero ndokusimbisa kuvandudza hunhu, ukuwo rimwe rakatsvaga chikonzero mukusaenzana kwehurongwa ndokukumbira kuvandudzwa kwemasangano. Kuti nharo dzemazuva ano dzehurongwa hwehurombo dzakafanana nekupikisana kwekare uku kunoratidza kuti midzi yedambudziko yakadzika zvakadini.
texts.g:894393a9: Boka revagari rakakumbira dare reruwa kuti rirake nzvimbo yemaminitsi aro anoburitswa. Dare rakanga rachengeta zvimwe zvirimo zvakavharwa nekuti zvingapinda muhupenyu hwakavanzika hwevanotaura. Asi mashoko ehurukuro yeveruzhinji anofanira kuongororwa neveruzhinji, uye kuvanza kunyange kukurukurirana kwehurongwa kusina chekuita nehupenyu hwakavanzika hakukwezvi zvikuru. Nzvimbo yeruzivo rwekuchengetedzwa inofanira kutsanangurwa zvakananga, nezvimwe zvose zvichiiswa pachena semutemo. Tsika yekutiza kuzivisa idare pacharo riri kuparadza kuvimba.
texts.g:ce1b883f: Ongororo iyi inoratidza kuti pane hukama hwakakosha pakati petsika dzekudzidzira muviri nezviratidzo zvekushushikana.
texts.g:88eee315: Kana nzira iyi ikaenderera, kudzikira kwedunhu kunogona kukurumidza.
texts.g:28c887ae: Zvinoreveswa kuti kukuvara kwakakura nekuti pakanga pasina kupindura nekukurumidza.
texts.g:a69a2570: Kunyange chinangwa chehurongwa chiri chakanaka, mibvunzo inosara nezvekururamisira kwekushandiswa kwahwo.
texts.g:d7136abe: Murairo uri kutsoropodzwa nekuti uchiri kusatevererwa zvakakwana panzvimbo yebasa kunyange mushure mekugadziridzwa kwawo.
texts.g:49a29231: Nyanzvi dzakafanotaura kuti danho iri rinogona kuita mugumisiro wenguva pfupi chete.
texts.g:6916a3e8: Pfungwa yekuti nyaya iyi inofanira kuonekwa sedambudziko rehurongwa pane kungova kutsauka kwemunhu pachake iri kuwana kuvimbika.
texts.g:58a6978f: Hurumende yedunhu yakazivisa kuti kutengesa kwemashopu mudunhu rayo kwakakwira ne12 muzana mushure mekuburitsa mavhawucha ekupa emuno mazhinji. Asi munguva imwe chete kutengesa mudunhu riri padyo kwakakwira nehuwandu hunenge hwakafanana, uye hafu yekushandiswa kwemavhawucha kwakaitirwa mumashopu makuru aivepo ane vatengi vazhinji vanogara. Sangano rakawedzera kuti data iyi bedzi inoita kuti zvive zvakaoma kuziva kuti mavhawucha akagadzira kushandiswa kutsva here kana kuti akangochinja nzira yekubhadhara yekushandiswa kwainge kwatoronga. Hurumende yedunhu yakati inoronga kuenderera nekuburitsa pamwero mumwe chete mukota inotevera.
texts.g:c70cd192: Dare reguta rakapasisa mutemo unorambidza mabhasikoro emoto ekutakura zvinhu kufamba panzira dzevanofamba netsoka, asi rakasarudza kunonotsa kuiswa kwawo negore rimwe. Nhengo dzedare dzakati pakanga pasina kupokana nezvekudiwa kwekushandisa mutemo. Zvisinei, zvakanongedzerwa kuti kana mutero wakatanga kuiswa pasina kufunga nezvehurongwa hwemari yevashandi vekutakura, kutyora mutemo kunogona kuenda kunzvimbo dzisingaonekwi zvikuru. Guta rakatsanangura kuti richawedzera nzvimbo dzekumira kwenguva pfupi panguva yekutenda. Shanduko yakapasiswa nemvumo yenhengo dzakawanda dzaivepo.
texts.g:7363c671: Marabhoritari mamwe matatu akaedza kudzokorora hunhu hweupfumi hwesimba redzimba mune chinhu chitsva chakazivisiswa neboka rimwe rekutsvaga, asi maviri avo akatadza. Boka rekutanga rakapindura kuti musiyano wekuchena kwesampuli ungava chikonzero. Kunyange rabhoritari rimwe rakabudirira rakati mwero wetembiricha yekuyera wakasiyana, zvichiita kuti kuenzanisa migumisiro zvakananga kuoma. Nharaunda yesayenzi haisi kurasa mugumisiro uyu nekukurumidza sekukanganisa kana kuugamuchira sechinhu chakabudirira. Kuti chinhu ichi chive chinoshanda, zvinofanira kutanga zvasimbiswa kuti hunhu hwakafanana huonekwa patembiricha yemba.
texts.g:04ed4bbd: Vatengesi vanoti sezvo musika wechinyakare wakava unozivikanwa senzvimbo yevashanyi, vashanyi vakawedzera zvikuru asi vatengi vanogara vakadzikira. Sangano rekutarisira musika rinoongorora kuti kutengesa kwakakwira nekuda kwevashanyi vekunze. Zvisinei, vamwe vatengesi vanotsanangura musika wemazuva ano se'zuva remusika rinoitwa, asi musika wakanyangarika.' Mutengesi akataura izvi akabvuma kuti kutengesa kwezuva nezuva kwakawedzera zvechokwadi, asi kwakadzikira. Sangano rakati rinoronga kuwedzera nzvimbo dzeruzivo dzevashanyi gore rinouya.
texts.g:28accf58: Hurumende yakazivisa kuti gore rino vanhu vane makore 60 kana kupfuura vakaumba kupfuura 20 muzana yevanhu vose vakashandiswa kekutanga muzvinyorwa. Zvisinei, kana manhamba akakamurwa, kuwedzera kwakawanda kwakabva kumabasa epfupi ehurumende ari pasi pemaawa gumi nemashanu pavhiki, uye mari yepakati yemwedzi yakadzikira chaizvo. Kutsoropodza kwekuti chiyero chebasa sechiratidzo chinotadza kuratidza mhando yebasa kwakadzokororwa panguva ino zvakare. Mumwe mukuru wehurumende akati ongororo yakasiyana nemapoka akadzama ichaburitswa mwedzi unotevera. Nyanzvi dzinoona kuti nhamba imwe chete inogona kutungamirira kuongororwa kwemitemo kwakasiyana zvichienderana nekududzira.
texts.g:c7538eaa: Pamusangano wekududzira, mumiriri akataura kuti izwi remutauro wekutanga rinenge rakazara tsika zvakanyanya, kuedza kuwana nekushandisa izwi rakaenzana naro kunodzikisa zvinoreva zvakanyanya. Akabvuma kuti mhinduro inoramba, yokuti kuwedzera nyaya dzepasi kunoputsa kunyatsonzwisisa kwomuverengi, ine chokwadi chiduku. Zvakadaro, akati aida kujeka kuti kududzira kwakareruka kuverenga hakusi nguva dzose kududzira kunotendeka kuchinyorwa chekutanga. Musangano wakasarudza kuita nyaya iyi musoro wenharo yepamutemo pamusangano wegore rinouya.
texts.g:8ba74f1e: Sangano rehurumende rakati richapa vaongorori zvinyorwa zvekufamba kwevagari, zvakabviswa mazita nekero. Sangano rakatsanangura kuti sezvo ruzivo rwose rwekuzivikanwa rwakanga rwabviswa, hapana kunetseka nezvokupindira kwehupenyu hwomunhu. Zvisinei, nyanzvi yezvemutemo yakataura kuti kuongororwa kwekunze kwenyika kwakaratidza mienzaniso apo vanhu vakati vakati vaigona kuzivikanwa nenzira dzekufamba kwavo kubasa nenguva dzavo chete. Sangano harina kupa maonero akasiyana pamusoro pechikamu ichi. Zuva rekuburitswa kwedata harisati rakagadziriswa.
texts.n:k.k10.media_headline:nounEnd: Misoro yenhau inowanzopera nezita kana chirevo chezita uye inosiya zviperengo zvezviito, saka musoro wenhau unoverengwa sechirevo chakadzvanyirirwa.
texts.n:k.k10.media_headline:commaClause: Koma mumusoro wenhau inowanzobatanidza zvikamu zviviri zvakadzvanyirirwa, sechikonzero kana chiitiko chinotevedzerwa nemhedzisiro yacho.
texts.n:k.k10.media_headline:leadStyle: Mutsara wekutanga wenhau unowanzopera nefomu rakajeka -다 (밝혔다, 분석했다, 기록했다) uye unopa chirevo kumufambiro nge -다고 밝혔다 kana -다고 분석했다.

[Nhau Dzinokurumidza] Guta rinoderedza kumhanya kwemotokari pakati peguta kusvika 40 km/h, kutanga mwedzi unouya
Kutanga mwedzi unouya, guta richaderedza kumhanya kwemotokari mumigwagwa mikuru yepakati peguta kubva ku50 kusvika ku40 kirometa paawa. Guta rakati ngozi dzevanofamba netsoka dzakaderera panguva yekuyedza, uye rinoronga kuongorora mugumisiro zvakare mushure memwedzi mitanhatu uye kusarudza kuti rikuwedzere kune mimwe migwagwa here.

texts.g:2c0a984c: Chirongwa chekuyedza kuvhurwa kweraibhurari manheru chichawedzerwa
texts.g:8df1fdab: Hofisi yedzidzo yeguta yakazivisa kuti kubva panguva yechikoro inotevera ichawedzera kuchengetwa kwevana mushure mechikoro muzvikoro zvepasi kusvika 7 manheru.
texts.g:91094162: Nyanzvi dzakaongorora kuti nechanza ichi chega, kukwira kwemitengo hakuzoiti nyore kudzikisa.
texts.g:ed0ce6a5: Kutengesa kunze kwenyika kwemwedzi wapfuura, kwakabatsirwa nekuita kwakasimba kwesemiconductor, kwakasvika padanho repamusoro remwedzi iwoyo.
texts.g:eca8dbcf:
[Muchidimbu] Kuvhurwa kweraibhurari manheru kuchawedzera... vashandisi vanofara zvikuru
Guta rakati kugutsikana kwevashandisi nekuvhurwa manheru kwemaraibhurari ehurumende, kunoitwa sechirongwa chekuyedza gore rino, kwakanga kuri kwepamusoro. Vazhinji vakapindura vakati zvakanaka nekuti vanogona kukwereta mabhuku kunyange mushure mebasa. Zvichibva pamigumisiro iyi, guta rinoronga kuwedzera maraibhurari gumi anovhurwa manheru gore rinouya.
texts.g:f804296d: Pepanhau rakaburitsa nyaya ine musoro unoti 'Mugumisiro wemari dzerubatsiro dzekutanga mabhizinesi evechidiki wakaratidzwa'. Asi mumuviri wenyaya, mwero wekurarama kwegore rimwe wevakagamuchira rubatsiro waingove mapoinzi 2 pamusoro pegungano rekuenzanisa, uye vaongorori vakatiwo sampuli yakanga yadiki uye yakaoma kuenzanisa kune vose. Nenzira iyi musoro wenhau une chirevo chakasimba kupfuura mhedziso yakangwarira yemuviri wenyaya.
texts.g:593213fa: Tsika yekushandisa mibvunzo mumisoro yenhau iri kukura. Pane kuzvidzivirira kuti zvinoratidza kungwarira kusingasimbisi zvinhu zvisina kusimbiswa. Asi musoro wakadai se‘Rubatsiro: ruchaita here?’ unosiyira vaverengi manzwiro asina kunaka bedzi kunyange muviri usingapi mhinduro. Zvinoreva kupinza chirevo zvinyoro nyoro nekuparadza chimiro chemubvunzo. Vaverengi vanowanzongotarisa musoro chete, saka havawani mukana wekugadzirisa manzwiro aya. Musoro wemubvunzo unogona kururamisirwa chete kana muviri uchipa zvikonzero zvemubvunzo uyu.
texts.g:0e25e2a6: Sezvo mujaho wenhau dzichangobuda uchikura, ruzivo rwusina kusimbiswa runowanzopinda mumisoro. Sezvo vaverengi vachida nhau dzinokurumidza, kukurumidza pachako hakugoni kupomerwa. Asi kunyange kana kukanganisa kururamisirwa shure, manzwiro akasiyiwa nomusoro wekutanga haaregi zviri nyore, nokuti zvinyorwa zvekururamisa hazviverengwi zvakapararira sezvekutanga. Kungoti kukurumidza nekurongeka zvinorwisana hazvireve kuti zvigadziriswe nokupfupisa nhanho yekusimbisa. Kunyange kana kuchibva kwanonoka, kudhinda zvakasimbiswa chete ndiyo nzira yekuchengetedza kuvimbwa.
texts.g:53030fa1: Musoro unoti ‘Ngozi dzebhasikoro dzawedzera kaviri’ unobata hanya yevaverengi pakarepo. Zvinogamuchirwa kutaura kuti kuisa mwero wekuchinja pakutanga inzira inobudirira yekudimbudza ruzivo. Asi kana huwandu hwekutanga huri hudiki, ‘kaviri’ hazvireve zvakawanda, nokuti musoro mumwe chete waigona kuitika kana nyaya imwe yakava mbiri. Zvinopesana, kana mazana enyaya akawedzera kaviri, musoro mumwe chete waizoita kurema kwakasiyana zvikuru. Kana mwero wekuchinja uchishandiswa mumusoro, muviri unofanira kuratidzawo huwandu hwekutanga kuti vaverengi vagone kuyera hukuru.
texts.g:bc267d69: Kuisa zviratidzo zvekutaura mumusoro nekuendesa chirevo sezvazvakaita zvinoita kuti zvione sekuendesa kusingaiti kwemunyori wenhau asina maonero ake. Chokwadi, nzira iyi inobatsira pakutapura chirevo pachacho zvakatendeka. Asi kana izwi rinonyanya kutsamwisa rangosarudzwa pachirevo chakareba rikaiswa mumusoro, kutaura kunova kusarudza kwete kuendesa. Zviratidzo zvekutaura zvingave kwete chivimbiso chekururama asi chiratidzo chekugadzirwa. Vaverengi vanofanira kuongorora mumuviri kuti mazwi ari mukati mezviratidzo zvekutaura akachekwa sei kubva pamamiriro awo.
texts.g:63ea35cf: Nyaya dzenhau dzinotevera chimiro chepiramidhi yakasimudzirwa chinoisa musimboti mundima yekutanga. Chimiro ichi chinobudirira nekuti chinoita kuti vaverengi vagone kunzwisisa musimboti kunyange vachisiya vachinge vaverenga kutanga chete. Zvisinei, kana nyaya yakaoma, kuisa mhedziso chete mundima yekutanga kunosundira zvinodiwa nezvinopikisa kumashure, saka vaverengi vanoverenga kutanga chete vanonzwisisa zvaitika nenzira iri nyore zvakanyanya. Mamiriro ekuti vaverengi vazhinji havaverengi kusvika kumagumo ndiwo anova kushaya simba kwechimiro ichi. Zviri nani kupfupisa mundima yekutanga asi kubatanidzawo chimwe chete chinodiwa chakanyanya kukosha.
texts.g:31402c52: Muverengi anoona musoro wenhau unoti 'Mitengo yevatengi inononoka' anogona kunzwisisa zviri nyore kuti mitengo yakadzika. Munhu anogona kuti zvinozikanwa nevanhu vanoverenga nhau dzehupfumi kuti mataurirwo akapfupiswa aya anoreva kuti kukwira kwakaderera. Zvisinei, vaverengi vose havabatani pfungwa iyi, uye kana 'kunonoka' chete kuchisimbiswa apo mitengo ichiri kukwira, zvinogona kupararira tariro isingaenderani nezvinonzwiwa nevanhu. Pakupfupisa mazwi ehunyanzvi, munhu anofanira kutanga afunga kuti vaverengi vane pfungwa imwe chete here.
texts.g:87c0595a: Izwi rekuti 'gakava' rinowanzoshandiswa mumisoro yenhau. Zvinofanira kubvumirwa kuti ndiro izwi rinoshanda rekuzivisa nyaya yakakamurwa pfungwa nenzira pfupi. Asi muchokwadi, 'gakava' rinoiswawo pakutsoropodza kunobva kuvashoma kana kufungidzira kusina hwaro hwakasimba, zvichiita kuti ritaridzike sekuti nzanga yose yakakamurwa. Izwi rimwe rinowedzera hukuru hwenyaya. Kuti shandisa mataurirwo aya, muviri wenyaya unofanira kuratidza zvakajeka kuti ndiani ari kupokana nei.
texts.g:f9c7128e: Hurumende yakasarudza kuwedzera mari yekuvandudza nekutsvaga mubhajeti yakaronzerwa gore rinouya kana tichienzanisa negore rino.
texts.g:ebceec56: Chikwereti chemhuri muchikamu chechitatu chegore rino chinonzi chakadzikira kekutanga muzvinyorwa.
texts.g:aba71c16: Vasingakwanisi kudzikisa misiyano nevatungamiriri mumutauriro wemubhadharo, mubatanidzwa wakasarudza kuisa mubvunzo wekumisa basa kuvhoti.
texts.g:bf376452: Vakuru vedhorobha vari kufunga kumisa mabasa emakambani akapfuura miganhu yemhando yemvura.
texts.g:6cd67870: Kutengesa kunze kwakawedzera asi zvinodiwa mukati menyika zvakaderera, saka kukwidziridzwa kwehupfumi kuri kunonoka.
texts.g:9425392b: Boka rekutsvaga rakati migumisiro inofanira kusimbiswa zvakare nenhamba huru yevanhu.
texts.g:16055c60: Shanduko iyi inotanga kushanda kubva pazuva rinouya mwedzi mitanhatu mushure mekuzivisa.
texts.g:07781593: Firimu rakapfuura vanhu miriyoni imwe chete mazuva matatu chete mushure mekuvhurwa, richikonzera dutu rekutengesa matikiti.
texts.g:0c1b4b47: Nyaya yenhau yakazivisa, pasi pemusoro unoti ‘Kushaya mabasa kwakakwira zvakanyanya, chiratidzo chedambudziko,’ kuti huwandu hwekushaya mabasa mwedzi uno hwakakwira ne0.3 mapoinzi muzana kubva mwedzi wapfuura kusvika ku3.4 muzana. Asi, chizivisiro cheSangano reMafambiro eMabasa chinoti ongororo inotarisa mhuri dzemuenzaniso uye ine kukanganisa kwehuwandu kwekubatanidza kana kubvisa 0.4 mapoinzi muzana. Shanduko iri mukati mehuwandu hwekukanganisa yakaoma kusiyanisa kuva shanduko chaiyo kana mhedzisiro yemukana wekusarudza muenzaniso. Naizvozvo, kunyange kana muviri wenyaya uchiendesa nhamba chaizvo, izwi rekuti ‘kukwira zvakanyanya’ mumusoro rakasimba kupfuura kududzira kunobvumirwa nenhamba. Zvakachengeteka kutonga mushure mekuongorora kuyerera kwemwedzi yakawanda kwete kuchinja kwemwedzi mumwe.
texts.g:b5385d29: Muongororo yemaonero pamusoro pechirongwa chekuvandudza guta idzva, 48 muzana vaitsigira uye 45 muzana vaipikisa, uye mukuru wenhepfenyuro akazivisa ‘Maonero ekutsigira kuvandudza ari pamberi.’ Kukanganisa kwemuenzaniso weongororo iyi ndekubatanidza kana kubvisa 3.1 mapoinzi muzana pamwero wekuvimba we95 muzana. Nokuti musiyano we3 mapoinzi pakati pekutsigira nekupikisa uri mukati mehuwandu hwekukanganisa, hazvigoni kutaurwa nehuwandu kuti divi ripi rakakura. Mumamiriro akadaro, kunyora kuti ‘maonero akaparadzana zvakaenzana’ izwi rakatendeka zvikuru kudata. Mushumo unotora hukuru hwenhamba zvakananga kuenda kuhurongwa unogona kuverengwa nevaverengi sechokwadi chakasarudzwa.
texts.g:408798cc: Bepanhau renharaunda rakadhinda musoro unoti ‘Ngozi dzebhasikoro mudunhu dzawedzera kaviri.’ Kana tichitarisa muviri, huwandu hwengozi hwakakwira kubva ku3 gore rakapfuura kusvika ku6 gore rino. Pachiyero bedzi ndiko kuwedzera kwe100 muzana, asi nokuti huwandu chaihwo hudiki, kunyange musiyano wemukana wenyaya imwe kana mbiri unochinja chiyero zvikuru. Zvinopesana, ngozi dzemotokari munzvimbo imwechete dzakawedzera ne5 muzana, kubva ku1,200 kusvika ku1,260, asi hadzina kuita musoro. Ndeipi divi ine njodzi inodiwa kuzivikanwa chaizvo nevaverengi? Munhu haafaniri kutora chiyero chinosimbiswa nomusoro sechinoratidza zvakananga kukosha kwenyaya.
texts.g:f1021423: Mugirafu yemabhawa munyaya imwe, mutero wepakati wedunhu A wakadhirowewa wakakwirira kupfuura kaviri wedunhu B. Asi mutsetse wakatsarukira haukanga wakatangira pa0 asi pa800,000 won. Nhamba chaidzo ndedze 920,000 won kuA uye 850,000 won kuB, musiyano wakangopfuura 8 muzana. Kana poindi yekutanga yakachekwa, kunyange musiyano muduku unoita sewakakura. Kunyange chimiro chegirafu chichiita sechinotsigira chirevo chenyaya, vaverengi vanokweverwa nemufananidzo wekuona kunze kwekunge vatarisa chiyero nezvikamu.
texts.g:9369abc2: Munyaya dzemamiriro ekunze, mataurirwo ekuti 'tembiricha yepamusoro-soro kubva pakatanga zvinyorwa' anoda kungwarira pakududzira. Semuenzaniso, nzvimbo yekuongorora yeOnsaemi yakanyora tembiricha kubva muna 1998, saka 'kubva pakatanga zvinyorwa' kwayo kungori kurongeka mukati mezvinyorwa zvemakore anenge makumi maviri. Haigoni kuiswa padivi kuenzaniswa nezvinyorwa zvenzvimbo dzakaongorora kwenguva inoda kusvika zana remakore. Uyezve, kana nzvimbo dzakatenderedza nzvimbo yekuongorora dzakava dzemaguta uye kupisa kuchiunganidzwa nyore, zvikonzero zvekukwira kwetembiricha zvinosanganisira shanduko dzemamiriro enzvimbo pamwe nekuchinja kwemamiriro ekunze. Saka mataurirwo aya angava echokwadi, asi izvi hazvirevi zvakananga kuti humbowo hwakananga hwekuchinja kwemamiriro ekunze.
texts.g:f28ddb3b: Musoro wenyaya imwe wairava 'Chinowedzerwa muchikafu A chinokwidza njodzi yekenza.' Asi mutsvagiri akataurwa mumuviri wenyaya akangoti, 'Muzviedzo zvemambera pakanga pane zviitiko zvakawedzera zvimvuri pamwero mukuru, saka hatigoni kuramba mukana wenjodzi kuvanhu zvakare.' Kutaura uku kwakanyanya kuenda kukuti njodzi haisati yarambwa pane kuti njodzi yasimbiswa. Musoro wenyaya wakaisa pasi mamiriro 'mukana' nemiganhu 'chiedzo chemambera' ukasiya mhedziso chete. Kutora mashoko hazvirevi kuti kungwarira kwemashoko iwayo kwakatakurwawo.
texts.g:8f4d8e8f: Vaverengi vakaona nyaya inonzi 'Mubhadharo wepakati wevashandi vemahofisi: 52 miriyoni won' vakanetseka kuti mari yavo yakanga isingasvike pakati. Asi tafura yeongororo imwe chete yakanyora pakati penhamba se41 miriyoni won. Kuti pakati pakakwirira kupfuura median nepamusoro pe10 miriyoni won zvinoreva kuti vashoma vanowana zvakawanda vakakwidza pakati. Mudata ine kugoverwa kuri kuenda kudivi rimwe, senge mari inowanikwa, pakati panogona kutadza kumiririra mamiriro evanhu vakajairika. Nhamba yakashandiswa mumusoro wenyaya yakanga isiri yekukanganisa, asi kunetseka kwakanzwiwa nevaverengi kunobva zvakanyanya pakusarudzwa kwechiratidzo.
texts.g:4cbac555: Zvine njodzi kutonga zvose zviri muchinyorwa nemusoro wenhau woga.
texts.g:56931683: Kana uchitora nhamba, sangano rakaita ongororo nezuva rekuongorora zvinofanira kutaurwa pamwe chete.
texts.g:477d9122: Misoro yenhau inowanzopfupisa zvirimo kuti ibate hanya yevaverengi.
texts.g:8aa920cb: Yakangoendesa chizivisiso sezvachakanga chiri uye haina kuongorora kana chiri chechokwadi.
texts.n:k.k10.proverbs_life:proverb: Tsumo ndedzimwe tsumo dzakagadzikana dzine zvinoreva zvemufananidzo zvidzidzo zvepasi rose, saka dzinoshandiswa sezvazvakazara uye kashoma kuchinjwa.
texts.n:k.k10.proverbs_life:nounEndP: Tsumo dzakawanda dzinopera nemutsara wezita usina chiito, uye dzinotaurwa chaizvo sezvadzakamira.
texts.n:k.k10.proverbs_life:pv: Tsumo kazhinji inotaurwa nechipetwa chakadai se-(이)라더니, -다는 말 kana -라고 했잖아 uye zvainoreva zvinobva kumamiriro ainotaura nezvawo, kwete kubva pakuverenga kwechokwadi.
texts.g:9d799c07: Kana ukataura zvakanaka kuvamwe, vachataura zvakanaka newe.
texts.s:9d799c07: Shamwari inotsamwira vose uyezve inonyunyuta kuti vanhu havana tsika kwairi.
texts.g:1b695257: Chenjerai zvamunotaura, nekuti mumwe munhu angagara achiteerera.
texts.s:1b695257: Uri kuda kuita makuhwa nezvemushandi akabatana newe pakona isina ruzha muhofisi.
texts.s:0408fcd8: Wanga uchingotaura nezveshamwari uye inopinda nemusuwo.
texts.g:7eb7e406: Kana mapati ane simba achirwa, vanhu vasina mhosva vari padivi vanokuvara.
texts.s:7eb7e406: Makambani maviri makuru ari mukurwisana kwemitengo uye vatengesi vadiki vari kutambura.
texts.s:26082fa8: Mubiki ane mukurumbira akapisa ndiro uye vashandi vakavhundutswa.
texts.g:f6696f7d: Tsika dzinogadzirwa muhudiki dzinogara hupenyu hwose.
texts.s:f6696f7d: Unoudza mubereki kuti nei kuchikosha kudzidzisa mwana mudiki tsika nekukurumidza.
texts.g:5f60263e: Zvidiki zvakawanda zvinowedzerwa zvinova chinhu chikuru.
texts.g:a77018bc: Unopa zvishoma uye unodzorerwa zvakawanda, kazhinji chinhu chisina kunaka.

texts.g:6d27989e: Kunyange nzira yaunofamba kazhinji ingave yakachinja nekuda kwekuvakwa, saka tinofanira kutora zvakanyanya zano rekubvunza nzira kunyange pane yatinoziva.
texts.g:3a277141: Pfungwa yakamutswa yekusiya kuongororwa kwekuchengetedzeka kuti kupfupise nguva yekuvaka. Zvino zvinoita sezvinobatsira nekuti hurongwa hwenguva hunotangwa nekukurumidza. Asi chiitiko chikangoitika, kuvaka kunomira kwemwedzi yakawanda uye kuzoteverwa nekupa mhosva. Tsumo yekuti 'kana uchikurumidza, tora nzira ndefu' inoshanda chaizvo munyaya iyi. Pane kukurumidza uchirasikirwa zvakanyanya, kutevera maitiro akarongwa kunoratidza kuva kwakakurumidza pakupedzisira.
texts.g:2dd11ef7: Pakudzidzisa vashandi vatsva, tsananguro dzevakuru dzinogara dzichisangana nedambudziko rimwe chete: kunyange vachitsanangura zvakadzama sei, hazvipinde kumunhu asina kuona nzvimbo yebasa. Sezvinotaurwa netsumo yekuti 'kunzwa kagumi hakuna kunaka sekuona kamwe', kuona muchina uchishanda nemaziso ako kunogona kuita kuti tsananguro dzemaawa dzinzwisiswe mumaminitsi. Izvi hazvirevi kuti tsananguro hadzidiwi. Kurongeka kunobudirira zvikuru ndekuvaka hwaro hwekunzwisisa kuburikidza neruzivo rwenzvimbo yebasa ndokurongedza kuburikidza netsananguro.
texts.g:4e66256a: Nzvimbo mbiri huru dzekutumira dzakakwikwidzana nokudzikisa mari dzikaita makwikwi ekushambadza zvakanakira varidzi vezvitoro. Asi makwikwi akati apera, kambani imwe yakatenga imwe, uye mushandisi mutsva akabvisa zvakanakira zvaakavimbisa. Vazhinji vanotaura pamusoro peizvi vachiti, ‘Kana mhizha dzichirwa, musana weshrimp unotyoka.’ Asi tsumo iyi inotsanangura chete mamiriro ekukuvadzwa pakati pekurwa; haiiti mamiriro mushure mekupera kwekurwa, apo mukundi anoita shrimp mudiwa mutsva wekutengeserana ozochinja zvinodiwa. Kurasikirwa kwevaridzi kunofanira kuonekwa sekusina kubva pakubatwa nemukana asi kubva pahurongwa hwakagadzirirwa kubva pakutanga kuti vavimbe nedivi rimwe.
texts.g:392498f6: Vanhu vanotsoropodza kuita nyanzvi vanodaidza mutsvakurudzi anofukidza chete munda mumwe zvakadzama kuti ‘gaka riri mugomba.’ Asi mvura inobuda chete kana gomba rakadzika. Dambudziko regaka hariri rekuti rinogara mugomba asi rekuti harigoni kufungidzira denga rakakura kunze kwaro. Mutsvakurudzi anoziva miganhu yemunda wake anotaura nemagaka ari mumagomba mamwe, anounza mibvunzo mitsva, uye anoishandisa kuchera gomba rake zvakadzika zvakare. Saka hazvidiwi kuzadza magomba asi kuvaka nzira pakati pawo.
texts.g:259c83de: Maererano nemushumo wesangano renhaka yetsika, kupfuura hafu yenzvimbo dzakawanikwa mumakore gumi apfuura dzakabuda nemukana pakuchera pasi kuvaka zvivakwa zvitsva. Vanhu vakafungidzira kuti vanoziva zvose nezvepasi peguta guru nokuti riri padyo. Tsumo inoti ‘Rima riri pasi pemwenje’ inoratidza rima rinobva kwete nokuti zvinhu hazvioneki asi nokuti hapana anoedza kutarisa. Dai chikamu chetsika yakadururwa pakuchera kure ichitendererwa kune iri pasi petsoka, kwaizova nenhaka isiri shoma yaigona kuchengetedzwa isati yakuvadzwa.
texts.g:a8777528: Pane kutenda kwakajairika kuti kana chirongwa chekutsvagurudza chakabatana chine vanhu vazhinji vari kutungamira, zvinhu zvinokanganisika. Asi kana tichitarisa mhaka dzekubatana kukuru kwekutsvagurudza pakati pemasangano akawanda, kunyange nemasangano akapinda ari pedyo nehuwandu hwakafanana, mamwe akabudisa mhedzisiro uye mamwe haana. Chakaparadzanisa hazvisi huwandu hwevanhu asi kana vakanyora pakutanga kuti ndiani aiva nesimba rekupedzisira rekusarudza. Chikepe chiri mutsumo hachina kukwira gomo nokuti vanhu vazhinji vaikwasva asi nokuti pakanga pasina ane kusarudza nzira. Naizvozvo kushandisa ‘Kana vatasvi vachikwira vazhinji, chikepe chinokwira gomo’ sehwaro hwekudzikamisa huwandu hwevanopinda kunoreva kutadza kuziva chikonzero.
texts.g:1f6577ed: Zvinotaurwa kuti nhengo dzakawanda dzekomiti yekuongorora vanhu vakashanda kwenguva refu muindasitiri iri kuongororwa. Nhengo dzinopindura kuti hunyanzvi hunodiwa kuti kuongorora kugone. Hapana chimwe chisiri icho. Asi, zvinoratidzwa netsumo ‘Chinyamukuta chinotsigira nkacha’ hazvisi unhu hwemunhu upi zvake asi chokwadi chekuti vanhu vakapedza nguva munzvimbo imwechete vanotarisa zvinhu nemitemo imwechete. Saka mhinduro haisi kuudza vanhu kuti vavimbe nehana yenhengo imwe neimwe kana kubvisa vose vari muindasitiri. Nzira inokwanisika ndeyekuburitsa zvido uye kuisa nhengo dzinobva kune mamwe mamiriro pamwero wakatarwa.
texts.g:b26c3202: Mushumo wemhedzisiro wechirongwa chekutsigira unoti huwandu hwekuwana mabasa kwevechidiki vakapinda hwaiva makumi masere nemashanu muzana. Asi, mabasa mazhinji aiva makondirakiti epfupi aingogara panguva yechirongwa, uye kunyange mwedzi mitanhatu mushure mekupera kwechirongwa, chikamu chaichiri panzvimbo imwechete chakanga chiri pasi pechimwe muvatatu. Muzhanje unoita seunonaka kubva kunze unogona kuzivikanwa chete pashure pekuruma. Kuyera mhedzisiro yechirongwa ichi, munhu anofanira kutarisa nyama, kureba kwekuramba ari pabasa, kwete ganda, huwandu hwekuwana basa. Zvechokwadi, hapana chikonzero chekuramba kunyange mukana wekuti mabasa epfupi anogona kuva kutanga kwebasa rose.
texts.g:0a684b7e: Tsumo yokuti tsika dzeuduku dzinoramba hupenyu hwose inowanzotaurwa sechikonzero chekudzidzisa vachiri vaduku. Izvi zvinokonzerwa nokuti munhu anogona kududzira kuti tsika dzakadzika muuduku dzinoramba kwete nokuti hadzigoni kushandurwa asi nokuti dzinodzokororwa pasina kunzwa kuda kudzishandura. texts.g:6a812acc: Sezvakazivisiwa pazasi, vanobata nyaya vanokumbirwa kuisa zvikumbiro vachitevera nguva yekupedzisira.
texts.g:1169c0b8: Hurongwa uhu hwakatsoropodzwa sepfungwa dzemudzidzo chete dzakatadza kuratidza zvakanaka manzwi ari panzvimbo.
texts.g:c93d7e85: Muchidimbu, chinangwa chekugadziridza uku chinodzokera pazvinhu zviviri, kureruka kwemaitiro nekusimbisa mutoro.
texts.g:8342bfa1: 'Kusabvisa kabhoni' kunoreva kuita kuti huwandu hwegasi rinopisa ine ruzha rinoburitswa huenzane nehuwandu hunotorwa kana kubviswa kuitira kuti kubuda kwakachena kuve zero. Izvi hazvirevi kubvisa kubuda zvachose; zvinoreva kuenzanisa zvikamu zvakaoma kudzikisa kuburikidza nekugadzira masango kana tekinoroji yekubata. Saka, kuwana kusabvisa kabhoni kunoda kuedza kwekudzikisa nenzira dzekuenzanisa.
texts.g:b726ec3e: A: Pfungwa dzakakamurwa pamusoro pekuderedza mwero wekubhadhara. Ngatitange kunzwa kuna Chiremba B. B: Kana mwero wedzikiswa, mutoro weinterisiti unodzika uye kushandisa kunogona kumutsiridzwa. Asi chikwereti chemhuri chiri chakakwira zvino, saka nzvimbo yekuwedzera ingagona kuenda pakubhadhara chikwereti pane kushandisa. C: Ndinonzwisisa kunetseka uku, asi hatigoni kungotarisa hupfumi huchinyura, handiti? B: Handipokani nekudzikisa pachako. Ndinoreva kuti kana mwero wakadzikiswa pasina matanho ekubata chikwereti, mugumisiro unotarisirwa unogona kuderedzwa nehafu.
texts.g:fbb5abf4: A: Pfungwa dzakakamurwa pamusoro pemutemo wekuwedzera CCTV mumigwagwa midiki. B: Kunyange paine ongororo dzinoti inobatsira kudzivirira mhosva, njodzi yekuti mavhidhiyo ashandiswe kupfuura chinangwa chawo yakakurawo. Saka ndinofunga kuti kusarudza chinangwa chekuisa nenguva yekuchengeta zvakajeka mumutemo chinhu chinodiwa kutanga. C: Ndinofunga kuti kuwedzera midziyo yekuongorora isina kusimbiswa mugumisiro iri dambudziko pacharo. B: Wakarurama kuti humbowo hwemugumisiro hunosarira. Asi zvakaoma kubvumirana nekudzivirira kuiswa zvachose. Tinogona kuishandisa kwenguva yakatarwa, kuongorora mugumisiro, uye kuisa ndima yekuibvisa kana pasina migumisiro.
texts.g:b74e7fde: A: Vamwe vanoti tinofanira kunonotsa matanho nekuti kufanotaura kwemisiyano yemamiriro ekunze kune kukanganisa. C: Kana nhamba dzichisiyana kubva pamodhelo kuenda kune imwe, hazvinzwisisiki here kumirira nemitemo inodhura kusvikira zvanyatsojeka? B: Ichokwadi kuti mamodhelo anosiyana. Asi musiyano uri wemwero wekukwira kwetembiricha, kwete kuti ichakwira kana kwete. Uyezve, kukuvara mumamiriro akaipisisa hakuenzaniswi nemutengo wekugadzirira. C: Zvino munoreva kuti kuvapo kwekusavimbika pachako hakusi chikonzero chekunonotsa here? B: Kuti kunonotsa kuve kwakarurama, kusavimbika kunofanira kuzunza kunyange kwakananga. Izvo hazvisi izvo zvino.
texts.g:8ac184e0: A: Tiri kukurukura kuti tipe rubatsiro rwevechidiki kuvechidiki vose here kana kune vane mari yakaderera chete. B: Kana ukakamura nemari yekupinza, vanogamuchira vanonzwa kunyadziswa, uye vechidiki vari pamusoro pemuganhu vanobva pakubatsirwa. Ndinoisa kurema pakubhadhara kwevose. C: Dambudziko ndemari. Kuti upe vose, unofanira kudzikisa huwandu zvikuru kana kuwedzera mitero. B: Handigoni kuramba izvozvo. Ndosaka ndisingakakavari kuita zvizere kubva pakutanga. Ndiri kufunga kutanga neboka remazera rakadzikiswa uye kuwedzera mushure mekuona mhedzisiro.
texts.g:c517e875: A: Hofisi yedunhu inoda kudzikisa zvitebhura zvebasa uye kuenda kukukumbira paintaneti. C: Kubata zvinhu paintaneti kunodzikisa mari uye kunopfupisa kumirira. Vashandi vezvitebhura vanogumira. B: Zviri pachena kuti kushanda zvakanaka kunowedzera. Asi kuvagari vasina kujaira masevhisi epaintaneti, chitebhura ndicho nzira chete. Kana nzira ichinyangarika, vanotanga kuva nenhamo vanowanzova vanhu vanowana zvakaoma kuita kuti mazwi avo anzwike. C: Asi dambudziko revashandi harina kugadziriswa. B: Saka handikurudziri kubvisa zvitebhura, asi kudzikisa kushanda panguva dzisingashandiswi zvikuru nokutendeukira vashandi ivavo kutebhura rerubatsiro.
texts.g:9e6048cb: A: Kuti shanduro yeshoko neshoko kana yakasununguka yakanaka here pakushandura nhetembo dzekare inyaya inokakavadzwa kwenguva refu. B: Ndinofunga shanduro yeshoko neshoko ndiyo inofanira kuva hwaro. Neyakasununguka pane njodzi yekuti kududzira kwemushanduri kunoendeswa kumuverengi sekunge ndiko kwekutanga. C: Asi kutamisa mazwi rimwe nerimwe hakusi kudzidza here kunosarudza zvinoreva? Hapana shanduro isina kududzira. B: Ndizvozvo. Munhu haapukunyuki kududzira. Zvandiri kureva hazvisi kubvisa kududzira asi kuti vaverengi vazive kwakapindirwa nokududzira. Zvinyorwa zvekuwedzera zvinoita basa iri.
texts.g:e5b59eb3: A: Nyaya iri ndeyekuti vashandi vemapuratifomu ekutakura zvinhu vanofanira here kutorwa semashandiro. C: Vanhu ava vakasarudza kuchinjika kwekushanda panguva dzavanoda, uye kana vachitorwa semashandiro, kuchinjika uku kunoparara. B: Ndinobvumirana kuti kuchinjika kunokosha. Asi kana puratifomu ichitonga kugoverwa kwebasa neari yekombuta, izvi zvinenge zvakafanana nekuraira chaiko. Zvisinei, handisi kuti nyaya dzose dzitorwe semabasa; ndinofunga huwandu hwekutonga hunofanira kuongororwa nyaya imwe neimwe. C: Zvino mungatsanangura sei kudzivirirwa kwakadai sechikwama chekukuvara kubasa? B: Zvakasiyana nekutonga nezvechinzvimbo chemushandi, tambo yekudzivirira inokwana pakukuvara inogona kugadzwa kutanga.
texts.g:1e59163a: Vanhu vakawanda vanosaina macontract vasingaaverengi zvakanaka, vozopinda mumatambudziko.
texts.g:83663cc4: Dare rakazivisa mupomerwi kuti haana mhosva nekuti humbowo hwakanga husina kukwana.
texts.g:7e63fc1e: Muuyo wekuedza uyu, vakachengeta tembiricha isingachinji, vakachinja hunyoro chete kuti vienzanise migumisiro.
texts.g:ae728982: Nekuti zvinodiwa mukati menyika zvakaramba zvakasimba kunyange kutengesa kunze kwakanonoka, chikamu chekukura hachina kuderedzwa zvakanyanya.
texts.g:45abc5d7: Muhoro yemitambo, kudzima runhare nekuda kuremekedza vamwe vanoteerera chiri chiremera chekutanga.
texts.g:0ad5b45b: Nekuratidza hupenyu hwezuva nezuva hwakajairika nenzira yakadzikama, bhuku iri rinoratidza zvakajeka maronda emavara.
texts.g:0b9af68a: Usati wapa chikumbiro, ndapota tarisa kuti magwaro ose anodiwa akakwana.
texts.g:99ad1e5c: Kukurumidza kwekukwegura kwevanhu, ndiko kunokosha zvakanyanya mubvunzo wekuti hurongwa hwemudyandigere huchachengetwa sei.
texts.n:k.k10.sino_four:fourChar: Tsumo dzemavara mana dzinobva kumavara echiChinese; silabheri imwe neimwe ine zvinoreva chimwe, uye chirevo chose chinoshandiswa semazita kana machipauro.
texts.n:k.k10.sino_four:ctx: Tsumo yemavara mana inonzwisiswa kuburikidza nechikamu chemutsara chakaipoteredza: mazwi echikonzero nemugumisiro pamberi petsumo anoratidza kuti mamiriro acho ane rombo rakanaka, rakaipa, rakanyanyisa kana anokodzera kurumbidzwa.
texts.g:9e86100f: Rombo rakanaka nerakaipa hazvizivikanwi, saka usafare kana kuora mwoyo nekukurumidza.
texts.g:72ae68d4: Kuva murima zvachose, usina chaunoziva nezvemamiriro ezvinhu
texts.g:74c7366e: Kuenzana zvekuti zvakaoma kutaura kuti chipi chakanakisa
texts.g:a92b93be: Kusagona kusarudza uye kutadza kuita sarudzo
texts.g:53d1fcc6: Kuzvikudza uye kubata vamwe sokunge vasipo
texts.g:c488bc66: Kasere kana kapfumbamwe pamakumi mapfumbamwe; zvechokwadi chose
texts.g:7dbd84a9: Kunyengerwa nenyengedzo inochinja chimiro asi kwete chikamu chikuru
texts.g:695af625: Kuva neruzivo rwakawanda uye kudzidza zvakakura
texts.g:06d330f8: Kushaya rubatsiro, pasina nzira yekubata mamiriro ezvinhu
texts.g:a50f326c: Kuva nemeso maviri; kunze kwemunhu kwakasiyana nemukati make
texts.g:bc110a30: Fekitori yakapiswa uye midziyo yose yakatsiviwa, uye nekuda kwaizvozvo kumhanya kwekugadzira kwakaita kaviri, saka chiri chokwadi chaicho chekukomborerwa kwakavanda.
texts.g:93a72436: Gore rimwe nerimwe rinotanga ndinopikira kuita masvomhu, asi sezvo ndisingapfuuri mazuva matatu, zvandakapikira zvinopera mushure memazuva mashoma.
texts.g:8138c19a: Kuenda kubasa nebhasikoro kunopa kurovedza muviri uye kunochengetedza mari yekufamba, saka kunouraya shiri mbiri nedombo rimwe.
texts.g:1ca73e05: Uyo akatyora chitsidzo akatsamwa panzvimbo pekukumbira ruregerero, izvo zvinoreva mbavha ichitsoropodza akabirwa zvakanyanya.
texts.g:50a57c06: Kurovedza muviri kunonzi kwakanaka kumuviri, asi kuita maawa gumi pazuva kunotonorwarisa, saka tsumo yekuti kupfuura mwero kwakaipa sekushaya kunoita chokwadi.
texts.g:bd35520a: Makambani maviri ari kusarudza chete zvikamu zvinodiwa zvehuwandu hwakafanana uye achitaura nenzira inodzitsigira.
texts.g:dd6e0f5b: Apo mudzidzi akawana mhedzisiro iri nani kupfuura mudzidzisi, mudzidzisi akafara akati mudzidzi apfuura tenzi wake.
texts.g:45b7572e: Kudzidza kuumbwa kwemba dzekare dzehanok uye kuishandisa pakuvaka kwemazuva ano muenzaniso wakanaka wekudzidza itsva kubva kune yekare.
texts.g:abb02c4f: Vashandi vekununura vakaenderera nekutsvaga masikati nehusiku kuti vawane vanhu vakarasika.
texts.g:966842b0: Munguva pfupi yapfuura, vanhu vazhinji vari kurasikirwa nemari huru mushure mekunyengerwa nemashoko akanaka anovimbisa 'mari yekutanga yakachengetedzwa uye purofiti ye20% pamwedzi.' Muhurongwa hwekuisa mari hwakajairika, purofiti inokura, njodzi inokurawo. Chivimbiso chepurofiti yakakwirira pasina njodzi chinofanira kuvhunduka nekuda kweizvozvo. Pane kunyengerwa nemashoko akanaka uchimhanyira, tinoda tsika yekutanga kutarisa kuti kambani yakanyoreswa nesangano repamutemo here.
texts.g:36da0494: Kambani yezvekudya yakavanza chigadzirwa chisina kukwana chayaiziva, asi munhu wemukati akaburitsa zvinhu zvose pachena pakupedzisira. Vanhu vazhinji vanopindura nekuzorora, vachiti kururamisira kunogara kuchikunda. Asi kuti mugumisiro wakagadziriswa hazvirevi kuti maitiro aivawo akarurama. Vatengi vakakuvara vakanga vatovapo, uye kana hurongwa hwekuongorora hwaiva husina simba chokwadi chingadai chakaramba chakavigwa. Kukunda kwekururamisira hakuiti pachako; kunogoneka chete kana masangano nehushingi zvichiritsigira.
texts.g:acf2b5ae: Tsumo yekuti zvakawanda zviri nani inogona kukodzera zvinhu, asi zvakaoma kuishandisa kuruzivo sezvarwakaita. Nezvinhu zvakawanda, hwaro hwekutonga hunoita sehunokura, asi muchokwadi nguva nesimba rinodiwa kusefa zvinodiwa zvinokurawo. Uyezve, kana zvinhu zvisingazikanwi kwazvakabva zvakasanganiswa, mhedziso inogona kuva yakavhiringidzika chaizvo. Chinokosha hachisi kuti wakaunganidza zvakawanda sei asi kuti unosarudza nekushandisa zvinhu zvinovimbika nenzira chaiyo sei.
texts.g:099e31d2: Vanhu vakarasikirwa nemabasa panguva yekudzikira kwehupfumi vanowanzopiwa kunyaradzwa neshoko rekuti 'Saeongjima.' Zvinoreva kuti zvakanaka nezvakaipa zvehupenyu hazvigoni kufanotaurwa, saka mazuva akanaka achauya kana ukamirira. Mukuru wekare munyaya haana kukurumidza kutonga rombo rakanaka kana rakaipa kana bhiza rake rakatiza kana rakadzoka. Asi shoko iri harirevi kugara pasina chaunoita uchimirira rombo rakanaka. Mashoko ekunyaradza haagoni kutsiva matanho. Zvinodiwa nevasina mabasa, pamwe chete nemaitiro ekugamuchira kusavimbika zvakadzikama, rubatsiro chairwo senge kudzidziswazve nekuchengetedzwa kwemari inopinda.
texts.g:52aa979d: Kambani payakaisa purani yekugadzirisa yaichengeta mubhadharo wose wegore wakafanana asi ichiwedzera chikamu chemabhonasi ebasa pachinzvimbo chekudzikisa mubhadharo wekutanga, mubatanidzwa wakapikisa, uchiti 'Josammosa.' Mbada munyaya yakanga yakapusa nekuti dzakarasikirwa nechokwadi chekuti, kunyange matatu mangwanani kana mana, aiva manomwe pazuva. Asi purani iyi ine chinochinja chisiri munyaya yembada. Mabhonasi anogona kudzikira zvichienderana nemigumisiro yekambani, uye mubhadharo wekutanga ndiwo chiyero chemubhadharo wekupedza basa nekuongororwa kwechikwereti. Kunyange nhamba dzose dzichiita sedzakafanana, kana ani anotakura njodzi achichinja, zvakaoma kuramba izvi seJosammosa.
texts.g:cdec0eb0: Mutambo wenzvimbo wakabudirira kukwezva vashanyi, uye vashanyi vakawedzera gore rega rega. Asi zviitiko zvaipinza vagari zvakadzikira uye danho rakachinjira kunyanya kuvaimbi vekunze. Pamusoro pekuchinja uku, kutsoropodza kwe'kuchinja kwemuridzi nemushanyi' kunomuka. Muridzi wemutambo anofanira kuva vagari vakachengeta tsika yawo, asi zvinodiwa nevashanyi zvakasvika pakusarudza zvirimo zvechiitiko. Asi hatigoni kupa mhosva kuwedzera kwevashanyi pachako. Dambudziko ndere kuti, nechikonzero chekugamuchira vashanyi, muridzi akasundirwa kunze kwenzvimbo yake. Kubudirira kwemutambo kunofanira kutongwa kwete nehuwandu hwevashanyi asi nekuti vagari vachimira here pakati pedanho.
texts.g:17a6db45: Vanhu vazhinji vanotaura 'Daegi-manseong' kupikisa pfungwa yekusarudza vana vane hunyanzvi nekukurumidza. Vanoti sezvo pane hunyanzvi hunotanga kutumbuka nekunonoka, hazvifaniri kuparadzaniswa nekukurumidza. Asi kupikisa uku kunewo mukaha. Nekuti Daegi-manseong inotaura nezvemugumisiro wechombo chikuru chichipedzwa nekunonoka, hairatidzi nyaya dzisingaverengeki dzakamirira kutumbuka nekunonoka dzikatadza. Kuunganidza nyaya dzekubudirira chete kukurukura nguva yekusarudza hakuzvikwani sehwaro. Chinofanira kuongororwa ndechekuti kusarudza kunopera mudanho rimwe chete here kana kuti mikana inovhurwa zvakare gare gare.
texts.g:ef984356: Pose pakamuka pfungwa dzekudzikisa bhajeti rekudzidziswa kupindura njodzi, tsumo ‘Yubi-muhwan’ inoshandiswa sendangariro yekuramba. Tsumo iyi haisi isiri iyo asi haina simba rekuita kuti vanhu vabvume. Kana gadziriro yabudirira, hapana chinoitika, saka mubairo wayo haupi chiitiko chinoonekwa. Chokwadi chekuti pakanga pasina ngozi chingava humbowo hwekuti kudzidziswa kwakanga kuri kwakanaka, kana humbowo hwekuti kudzidziswa kwakanga kusingadiwi kubva pakutanga. Naizvozvo kuti vaiona bhajeti vabvume, hazvidiwi mutsara asi data inofungidzira kukuvadzwa kwaizoitika pasina kudzidziswa.
texts.g:7d9c642e: Mugadziri akaita kushambadza kukuru kwekusimudzira hutungamiriri hunochengeta zvakatipoteredza, asi zvinyorwa zvake zvekuburitsa zvinoti kuburitsa kwemhepo inopisa kwakasimuka munguva imwecheteyo. Zviri nyore kuti izvi zvitwe ‘Pyori-budong.’ Asi Pyori-budong zvinoreva kuti kunze nemukati zvakasiyana, uye kuti utaure izvozvo unofanira kuziva mukati. Kana kushambadza kuchitsanangura hurongwa hwekudzikisa kuburitsa uye hurongwa hwacho huchiri pakuitwa, musiyano nenhamba dzazvino ungangove kunonoka kwenguva kwete kunyengera. Sarudzo inofanira kuitwa mushure mekusimbisa kuti hurongwa hwekudzikisa hwakananga sei uye kana hunoitwa sezvakavimbiswa.
texts.g:5b588c16: Chikwata chakashanda pamwe chete kwenguva yakareba chinofambirana pasina kutaura. Vanhu vanochidaidza kuti ‘Isim-jeonsim’ uye vanochiona sekubatana kwakanakisa. Asi nzira iyi ine mutengo. Zvinodiwa zvinogoverwa zvakanyarara hazvisiyiwi mumagwaro, saka zvinonyangarika pakarepo kana nhengo dzachinja. Uyewo, kutenda kuti ‘tinoziva pasina kutaura’ kunobvisa mukana wekuratidza kuti mumwe nomumwe anonzwisisa zvinhu zvakasiyana. Isim-jeonsim inoratidza simba rayo chete pahwaro apo zvinodiwa zvakakosha zvakatonyorwa.
texts.g:c86776f8: Chirongwa chakaita mutambo mukuru wekutanga asi chakanga chisina zvakawanikwa zvakawanda, saka chakaguma chadzikira.
texts.g:af636628: Mitengo yezvinhu zvekugadzira yakakwira uye mitengo yekuchinjana mari yava isingagadzikani zvakare, mamiriro ezvinhu apo dambudziko rimwe rinotevera rimwe, saka kambani yakaisa parutivi hurongwa hwayo hwekuisa mari.
texts.g:383161c6: Vatongi vakapa makisi akakwirira nokuti mumiriri akagara akadzikama uye akabata kunyange mibvunzo isingatarisirwi nekuchinjika panguva iyoyo.
texts.g:efbd5c64: Vakwikwidzi vari kutarisa vachishuvira mukana wekutora chikamu chedu chemusika, saka iyi haisi nguva yekuzorora.
texts.g:96c6433c: Nyanzvi iyi inozivikanwa semunhu ane ruzivo rwakawanda, anonyatsoziva kwete nhoroondo chete asi nyeredzi nekurapa.
texts.g:fac27988: Mamiriro emusangano akadzika pamushumo waidzivirira pakati pemubvunzo ukatsaura nezvisingaenderani.
texts.g:40dc49d8: Maitiro asingasarudzi ekuisa sarudzo parutivi nekuchinja maonero zvinoita kuti zvive zvakaoma kuwana kuvimbwa kwenhengo dzechikwata.
texts.g:05e2223f: Kana chibvumirano ichi chikawa, kambani yatinobatana nayo ichagumisa kutengeserana nesu zvechokwadi.
